articleTitle: Economic impacts and reliability evaluation of battery by adopting Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Electric vehicles have received a lot of exposure in recent years as their technical ability has improved. The transportation field is rapidly transitioning to electric vehicles in order to reduce carbon emissions in industry and reduce its reliance on petroleum. Many countries have established aims for increasing the percentage of electric vehicles on the road in the near future. Meanwhile, many incidences involving two-wheelers exploding into flames have concerned India's electric vehicle aficionados. The work is significant in that it analyses the economic impacts and causes of failure for battery installation, particularly for two-wheelers, in a developing nation like India. Even though several investigations have carried out to explore the social effects of EV adoption, limited information is available about the broad implementation of EVs that may influence both battery life and economic factors at the same time. By having a complete impact evaluation of EV adoption, this work aims to fill the research gap.

articleTitle: Implementation of Internet-of Things (IoT) in Soil Irrigation System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Solutions to issues faced in the conventional soil irrigation system have been obtained by integrating Internet of Things (IoT) technology. A prototype IoT device is designed to monitor and control water supply to the plants using a Node MCU, microcontroller, moisture, temperature, humidity, and rainfall sensors. The wireless sensor network system has been applied to transfer the data and control water supply to the soil irrigation system. The analogue signals received from sensors have been processed by the microcontroller unit based on the user's requirements. The ‘C’ language is used to make the microcontroller code based on the logical aspects. The Blynk software application has been used to analyze the MCU data and convey the information about temperature, rainfall, amount of water, and humidity of the soil to the user through an e-mail alert. An IoT system can be used to minimize water wastage and minimize the overall cost of the soil irrigation system.

articleTitle: Prominent Rule Control-based Internet of Things: Poultry Farm Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In this article, the various poultry farm parameters such as antitheft, fire protection, temperature, humidity, oxygen, carbon-di-oxide, ammonia gases, and light of the poultry have been monitored by the Prominent Rule Control (PRC) algorithm in Internet-of-Things devices. Food and water supply, fire and theft safety, air purity, and air conditioning in the poultry farm have all been conducted using sensor signals. In this system, power consumption, labour costs, time, and effective utilization of power and resources have been monitored to enhance the poultry production rate. The PRC algorithm has been working to simplify the process and save time for overall poultry monitoring and activating systems with low cost. It is also employed to condition the sensors' data, convert it, compare it with threshold values, write the Arduino program, and securely store it in the cloud system for the poultry system. This research is also focused on improving the poultry monitoring system and minimizing the fixed and operating costs of the IoT system. The microcontroller, GSM module/WIFI, temperature and humidity sensors, proximity sensors, fire sensors, different gas sensors, RFID, and light sensors have been working to monitor the poultry form. The egg collectors, fogger systems to decrease the temperature, water and food supply systems have been established and integrated with microcontrollers to perform the automation in the poultry farm.

articleTitle: IoT Based Water Showering Mechanism in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: There are various methods to improve farming in agriculture but the current trend in the technology field is the Internet of Things. Usage of IoT helps farmers to shower the water in the field. Fertilizer can be used instead of water. By using various types of sensors in the field, rain prediction is possible. Moisture sensor, DHT11 sensors and MQ2 gas smoke sensors are used in the field. By using these sensors, the moisture level of the soil, humidity, temperature and CO2 level in the surroundings of the field can be detected. The proposed method uses Machine Learning algorithm to predict the rain from the data obtained from the sensors. The Raspberry Pi serves as the project's brain, connecting all of the field sensors and transmitting the sensor data necessary to forecast rain. Gradient Boosting, KNN, Gaussian Naive Bayes, Random Forest, XG Boosting, Decision tree algorithms are used to predict the rain and to give good percentage of accuracy for the data. Testing and training the data sets is done using elbow method, cluster method, confusion matrix to give more accurate result. Hence according to the result, the water will shower in the field.

articleTitle: Lithium-ion Battery Management System: A review
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The practical design of an Electric Vehicle (EV) relies on battery characteristics, and various types of batteries available on the market. Owing towards it, the lithium-ion battery is found to be the best alternative for commercial applications due to its high energy density, the amount of energy stored by their physical weight, a low self-discharging and low cost. In order to keep the total electric vehicle system safe, effective, and reliable, battery packs must be routinely checked and controlled. Since a Battery Management System (BMS) is being constructed, the battery pack alone could not function or reach its maximum capacity unless some strong, effective, and cutting-edge controls being created around it. BMS perform the following activities: battery health monitoring, temperature monitoring, cell balancing, thermal management, etc. For the measurement, different analog/digital sensors are used in conjunction with microcontrollers for monitoring purposes. As a result, this paper can be a useful resource for researchers who are interested to the application of battery management systems and related topics.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Heart Disease Prediction Using KNN and RTC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Heart Disease or cardiovascular disease refers to the range of heart conditions like cardiac arrest, coronary artery disease. Heart disease can be very well hindered through certain lifestyle changes. There is a significant increase in the mortality rate recently due to the distinctive heart diseases. Machine learning uses mathematical models to work efficiently with the enormous amount of data. It plays a crucial role in medical science in the prediction of distinctive diseases. Cardiologists inspects the heart functionality using electrocardiography, computed tomography. These tests are quite expensive for a common man. Recent times, the life span of a human is guaranteed only with the support of medications. As prevention is better than the cure, machine learning helps to predict the vulnerability of a heart disease with few elemental symptoms and health factors. It is been fed by the basic data of the patients like age, sex. Machine learning helps to predict the vulnerability in advance which provides the cardiologists with great acumen for the adaption of the treatment. Machine learning algorithms have proven to produce reliable and accurate output with the help of the inputs. The algorithms used in the article include KNN and decision tree classifier which is compared to yield the desired and efficient output.

articleTitle: A Review on Electric Vehicle Adaptation: Challenges, Standards and Policy Options
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: With the economic growth and industrial revolution, the world is witnessing burgeoning growth in vehicles on the road. Soon, the transport sector became the largest energy consumer after the industrial sector. However, at the same time, it also appeared as the primary source of emission of greenhouse gases and air pollution worldwide. Conventional transport technology uses an internal combustion engine that operates on fossil fuels. However, fossil fuel is depleting continuously. It leads a movement toward an alternative transport technology. Consequently, Electric Vehicles (EVs) evolved and grabbed the attention of governments and automobile companies worldwide. Many strategies, policies, and schemes are adopted to promote it. Still, its market share is relatively low. To adopt electric vehicles primarily, it must satisfy worldwide standards. Government policies and regulations also need to be developed and examined from time to time. This article investigates electric vehicle standards, related policies, and regulations.

articleTitle: Impact of Solar Energy on Mitigating Climate changes for a Sustainable Development in India
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Green gas emission is a universal problem. Majority of the energy requirement of the Indian economy is been accounted by imported fossil fuel. Contribution of renewable energy resources is very less in the total energy requirement. Solar energy is one of the better alternate energy source to fulfill the needs of Indian energy requirement as geographically it is near the equator. Indian government has come up with many policies and initiatives to increase the footprint of solar energy there by reducing the carbon foot print. The current study investigates the impact of Indian government policies and initiatives taken to mitigate the green gas emission for a sustainable development in India. The analysis shows that there is a steep increase in production of solar energy as a source of renewable energy in India. But the amount of green gas emission is more due to the rapid industrial growth in India. So Government of India must take more steps to popularize the use of solar energy as an alternate energy sources in the sub-continent to reduce the green gas emission for a sustainable development.

articleTitle: LSTM Method for Human Activity Recognition of Video Using PSO Algorithm

abstract: A most alluring method is Human Activity Recognition (HAR) from video, cost-effective computer vision-based recognition research and it has wide range of applications such as Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) surveillances, gaming and health care unit. The recognition of human activity labeled by the appearance and motions observed from the video. The rise of social informatization, the prominent information technology mentioned by machine vision is applied to many more scenes. The conventional methods of HAR facing problems such as slower recognition and precision rate are low. With the advancement of deep learning approach, the difficulties faced in HAR are addressed. For this analysis, various kinds of neural network have been recommended by researchers and they did HAR effectively. The dataset chosen for this study includes variety of actions including such as pushups, mixing, kayaking, playing basketball, drumming, etc. This approach improves the temporal and spatial dimensions to maximize the recognition rate. articleTitle: Light GBM Algorithm based Crop Recommendation by Weather Detection and Acquired Soil Nutrients
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A significant part of sedentary human civilization is agriculture. The crop yield will grow with the correct kind of crop planted. Systems for making recommendations can be made using a variety of machine learning techniques. According to the agricultural criteria, crop recommendations are made. With the aid of data science, a suggestion system can be given to the farmer to help him plant crops. Numerous resources might be lost in the event of quality prediction. We have applied the Light GBM Machine Learning Algorithm to address this flaw in the current system and enhance its accuracy and dependability. Based on the analysis of data sets and consideration of environmental elements and soil nutrient concentration, crop recommendations were developed. The recommendation system trustworthy. Using a third-party API, the environmental variables temperature, humidity, and air pressure are discovered. articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In many difficult and complex settings, wireless sensor networks can be set up, and they frequently have hundreds of sensor nodes. Sensor nodes always make use of cheap chips, which increases their susceptibility to malfunctions or errors during operation. Environmental factors and electromagnetic interference may also affect how well the WSNs work. When a sensor node malfunctions, it may be because it has died and communication with other nodes is no longer possible within the wireless network, it is still alive but is producing false data, or it is unstable and switches between the proper and defective states. Defect diagnosis has been the focus of numerous studies to enhance the quality of data, speed up the response time, strengthen security, and extended network lifetime. According to the decision-making processes and salient features of the employed algorithms, the fault diagnostic techniques from the previous five years are categorized into three groups in this survey research: centralized, distributed and hybrid methods. This paper compares these investigations, discusses their advantages and disadvantages, and offers future research based on well-established theories and methodologies because each of these studies had unique goals and limitations.

articleTitle: Railway Accident Prevention Using Ultrasonic Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Railway transport is indispensable in this modern world. Now-a-days, train networks have become more busier carrying more passengers and goods. It results in increased demands in inspection and maintenance of rail assets and improper tracking or detection of people, animals or any other vehicles inside the railway track. So, there is a lot of chances for accidents and loss of lives and resources. But these unexpected accidents can be avoided and prevented by using this railway accident prevention technology using ultrasonic sensors. This technology detects the obstacle inside the railway track using ultrasonic sensors and alerts us using alarm. By using this system, we can also stop the train automatically when the obstacle stays inside the track even after the alarm sound. The train can be stopped by providing air brakes.

articleTitle: Parkinson's Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a progressive central nervous system disorder characterized by tremors, vocal cord disorders, bradykinesia, and slurred, slow speech. After Alzheimer's disease, it is the second most prevalent neurological disorder. Approximately 6,3 million people worldwide are affected by this disease. It is caused by the death of dopamine-producing neurons and primarily affects those over the age of 60. Parkinson's disease does not have a cure, but early detection may be able to slow the disease's progression. Using speech analysis and gait analysis data, researchers have spent the past few years working on the detection and monitoring of Parkinson's disease. Machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) techniques are gaining popularity because they can automate the process of accurate pattern recognition. Approximately 90% of patients with PD suffer from motor impairments. Then, datasets are obtained, and using Histogram of Oriented Gradients, specific features are extracted (HOG). The datasets are examined to determine if the individual has Parkinson's disease. Using an artificial neural network's Random Forest Classifier and a patient dataset containing spiral and wave-like drawings, we intend to predict this disease. The result of the computing method is then computed, analyzed, and improved output is obtained.

articleTitle: Intelligent Movement Tracking Robot

abstract: Due to their numerous uses in manufacturing and modern society, Human Following robots have been studied and actively developed for many years. The robot needs to use a variety of methods, including robot control algorithm, human target detection, and obstacle avoidance. This project showcases a four-wheeled robot that follows people while equipped with an ultrasonic sensor to prevent collisions. The user is located by the robot using feedback from ultrasonic sensors. This robot can assist humans in carrying a variety of accessories, luggage, and highly sensitive chemicals in a number of different applications. Using ultrasonic sensors, an algorithm was created to track and position a human user while maintaining a constant distance from the robot. In the presence of numerous such obstacles, the IR sensors are used to uniquely identify the user. The most crucial element for an autonomous robot is communication between the robot and the user. There has been a noticeable increase in awareness of the use of these technologies. The creation of such robots is tangentially related to this research. Fully autonomous robots ought to be able to connect with the person controlling them in some way in addition to performing the tasks that are expected of them. Two IR sensors and an ultrasonic sensor are employed. Ultrasonic sensors are used to move the robot backward and IR sensors are used to follow a person or object.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis on Sediment Classification using Convolutional Neural Network

abstract: In this proposed work, we trained the neural network models for feature extraction and categorize the underwater seafloor sonar images into sediments, sands, mines, rocks, mud, gravels, etc using Convolutional Neural Network such as ResNet50, Inceptionv3 and VGG-19. Moreover, the performance of neural network is estimating by metrics measures such as validation accuracy, accuracy, loss, and accuracy loss upto 10 epochs. articleTitle: Cooperative Sensing with Heterogeneous Spectrum Availability in Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In cognitive radio, the throughput efficiency of the secondary user (SU) is determined by spectrum sensing performance and the secondary user's available power to send data. Because the secondary user expends energy for spectrum detection and to maintain cooperation among numerous SUs, transmission power can be reduced. To compensate for this energy, cognitive radio has devised an energy harvesting technology in which the SU may harvest energy from the primary (PU) signal and use it to broadcast data and extend the lifetime. In a typical Energy Harvesting Cognitive Radio Network (EHCRN), SU can perform sensing and harvesting in different slots, reducing the secondary user's transmission time and lowering throughput. In a cooperative wireless network with energy detecting spectrum sensing, the RF energy harvesting approach is researched, and various optimization studies are investigated in this work. First, an energy harvesting is considered with the power splitting technique, Power Splitting Energy Harvesting Cognitive Radio Network (PSEHCRN) to measure the residual energy of SU that can be utilize to improve the transmission efficiency of SU and obtained expressions for throughput and lifetime. Further an energy harvesting with adaptive time switching mode of operation namely Adaptive Time Switching Energy Harvesting CRN (ATSEHCRN) has proposed and analyses the performance in terms of harvested energy, transmission power, throughput and lifetime of SU. This research also offers the Optimum Energy Harvesting Cognitive Radio Network (OTEHCRN)., an optimum energy harvesting technique that can perform spectrum sensing and energy harvesting simultaneously, with the entire incoming radio frequency (RF) power being utilised for energy harvesting. Reduced energy consumption paired with higher energy harvesting allows more energy to be accessible for transmission, resulting in increased SU throughput and longevity. Harvested energy, transmission power, throughput and lifetime are analysed with half duplex and full duplex mode of energy harvesting and compared with the different energy harvesting schemes. The cognitive radio performance of all studies has been verified with MATLAB simulation results.

Author Keywords: Power Splitting Energy Harvesting Cognitive Radio Network

articleTitle: Animal Intrusion Detection and Ranging system using YOLOv4 and LoRa
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Man animal conflict is on an exponential rise in the past few years. This is mainly due to the rise in human population, and rapid urbanization and globalization. This puts pressure on the ecological balance of the world. In this article, we propose a novel system to deal with the maintenance of crop fields from animal intrusion and mainly we propose the system to provide a system to prevent man-animal conflict. We propose an integrated system with YOLOv4 and LoRa which can detect the presence of wild animals and can alert the wildlife authority.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface Based Microstrip Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The development of reconfigurable intelligent surfaces has shown how to improve a variety of areas of next-generation communications. With the pressure put on it, scalable networks of propagation are provided. The antenna features a stretchable antenna with reconfigurable abilities. This work describes a narrowband, highly effective smart antenna whose reconfiguration changes depending on the stress applied to it. The developed patch antenna has dimensions of 80×29.4 mm2. The physical characteristics of the EVA substrate tend to alter when an external stretch force is applied, which also affects the substrate's dielectric characteristics. The suggested antenna provides a 3.6GHz frequency with improved gain and VSWR characteristics. As a result, the work is applicable for 5G NR FRl, Wi-Fi 6E, UWB, and Wi-Max applications.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Authentication System for Improved Security
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the era of technologically developed world, itis necessary to update our security systems to make living easier. The ultimate aim of our proposed system is to impart security to the object which is supposed to be under protection and that which should be accessed only by an authenticated person. The object may be chosen as a door lock of a home or a private cabin or a separate locker. The proposed security system works in a smart way that when someone nears the object, the presence of the person will be detected, further the photo of the person is captured. The system is designed and implemented through the MATLAB along with the pre-existing dataset. Further it employs facial recognition which has the ability to identify the authenticated person using Viola Jones algorithm and classification performed with CNN. Once it is identified as authorized person, the lock opens automatically and access will be provided. On the other hand, if an unauthorized person is detected, the owner is intimated via the e-mail. Once the classification is done, the respective details will be updated in the Adafruit webpage for future reference of the corresponding owner. This system provides an opportunity to serve old age people and to identify unauthorized intruder. Further it possesses an advantage over conventional lock and keys.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Pipe inspection Snake Locomotion Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Inspection robots are designed for inaccessible environments like perilous work place and confined spaces. In pipelines, curbed spaces are investigated with small sized snake inspired locomotive robots, as humans and other legged robots cannot do. The goal of this project is to design, create, and test a snake robot that takes design cues from actual snakes. To inspect and check for damages or block in pipelines of industries, nuclear plants where Snake bots can be used. The proposed prototype consists of 6 servomotors connected via actuated joints to produce snake-like flexible motion. The Snake-bot is capable of a range of movements, including slithering, rolling, standing up to pull itself over barriers, and climbing. The head of the snake is configured with camera and ultrasonic sensor. The snake robot is therefore perfect for search activities. The pulse width signal is converted and the snake robot is moved using an Arduino -UNO. The programme runs and issues commands to the parallel-connected servo motors. Servo motors aid in the movement of an autonomous vehicle.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition Using LSTM Network with Dropout Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) is one of the fields where the research is going on in the field of deep learning and machine learning. As the everyday work that we do is ubiquitous (present everywhere), it would be helpful if a model can predict the activities performed. Many unsupervised techniques were used before but with the advent of deep learning techniques and neural networks, it has become easy for us to train and test the datasets with more accuracy. Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) will be used as we will be working on time series data. RNNs use Backpropagation through time (BPTT) algorithm. The Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) model combined with the dropout mechanism deal with issues of vanishing gradients and overfitting of the model. LSTM consists of a cell state for preserving memory and forgetting it, whereas dropout nullifies some active states, allowing other states to participate and train the data. In this project, a better strategy has been considered that is easier to implement than the existing deep learning models that are contemplated here. This method achieved a high accuracy of 92.67% on the experimented dataset.

articleTitle: IoT and Cloud Server based Industry Power Monitoring and Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Most organizations seeking to boost their energy efficiency discover that there are insufficient Business Intelligence solutions to support their dynamic cycle and execute appropriate energy-efficiency project frameworks. articleTitle: Vehicle Theft Detection and Driver Identification System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: It has become increasingly important to detect vehicle theft as the number of thefts increases. New strategies are being developed to overcome and prevent vehicle theft. The downside of vehicle theft is a result of recent technological advancements. This work proposes the use of Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) cards, authorized keys, Global Positioning System (GPS), and cameras to prevent vehicle theft and means to identify the person driving the vehicle. The RFID reader is connected to the car and requires card authorization to enter the car. The vehicle location is tracked by the use of GPS module. The camera captures the image of the driver and checks the driver's identity. If the car is stolen, the camera takes the picture of the thief and sends the location and the profile of the thief to the vehicle owner via Short Message Service (SMS). Using GPS technology, the proposed system provides regular notification to car owners about the position of their cars. The second case uses the camera for authorization and if the person is authorized then there will be no wheel locking. if the person is not authorized, it will show unauthorized access and alert the owner of the car. The location of the vehicle is tracked using GPS. If there is any tampering with the vehicle the GPS position of the vehicle is tracked and sent to the owner of the car.

articleTitle: Video Based Forest Fire and Smoke Detection Using YoLo and CNN

abstract: Forest fire is a matter of concern as it affects our ecological cycle and incurs a huge economical loss. articleTitle: Securing IIoT sensors communication using blockchain technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Industrial IoT (IIoT) advances organisations to the next level by tracing and managing all entity activities. Moreover, the deployment, dependency, and interaction of these wireless devices, often known as IoT (Internet of Things) devices, creates a number of privacy and security problems.
