articleTitle: A Review on Machine Learning and Deep Learning based Rainfall Prediction Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Water for farming and storage capacity in dams are both affected by the quantity of precipitation that falls. Predicting when and how much rain will fall is challenging because of global warming and other variables. Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Deep Learning (DL) may use factors like the amount of rainfall in previous years, climatic change, climatic conditions, and so on to forecast rainfall in a given area. Potential flooding and damage to man-made structures might result from unexpected rainfall. Comprehensive data categorization and investigation, evaluation, inquiry, and interpretations are needed to uncover rainfall that will help governments avert human deaths, agricultural failures, and animal fatalities. The development of ML and DL systems is ongoing to assess and manage crucial rainfall data. Therefore, the purpose of this research is to investigate the potential of using ML and DL approaches to forecast precipitation for future planning of human settlements and related activities. Prediction methods in ML are investigated, including regression, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM). The benefits and drawbacks of using neural network algorithms and ML algorithms are also discussed in this paper, with each approach taking into account the data and features at hand. New developments in the field of precipitation forecasting are also covered, including studies that use a wide range of feature extraction and prediction methods. In this study, we discuss many ML methods and algorithms for predicting rainfall based on historical data and other criteria.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization for Enhanced Ethanol Production during Whey Fermentation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Whey fermentation is an important anaerobic fermentation process to produce lactic and alcoholic beverages like ethanol from by-products of cheese and dairy industries using various microorganisms like lactic acid bacteria and yeast. One of the significant parameters affecting the quality and quantity of ethanol yield is Dissolved Oxygen(DO) etc. In this paper, a multi-objective control scheme is proposed for achieving quality and cost of ethanol yield by optimizing DO in fed-batch fermentation of Kluyveromyces Marxianus. Firstly, the DO is controlled by manipulating substrate feed rate with conventional Proportional Integral (PI) controller. Secondly, a multi-objective control problem is formed to optimize PI controller parameters to achieve minimum Integral Error (ISE) to improve quality of ethanol product and minimum control effort to minimize cost of product and successfully solved by NSGA-II. The performance of the proposed controller is analysed under servo and regulatory operations It is found experimentally that the proposed NSGA-II algorithm gives optimal solutions to the DO problem.

articleTitle: Intelligent Image Text Reader using Easy OCR, NRCLex & NLTK
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Intelligent Image Text Reader is capable of capturing an image and extracting the text from the image using the Easy OCR library and displaying them in the form of speech output. The Text to Speech conversion methodology was earlier useful for the visually impaired but now it has got a wider scope. In the era of Digitalization, text is seen almost on all the online web sites, blogs, and e-learning materials. Text plays a vital role in some of the real-time applications like the vehicle license plates, traffic sign boards, banners and so on. Our proposed methodology is not just capable of identifying the text in the images but is also capable of translating the text from a common language to one's own native language with the help of Google Translate, additionally these texts are converted to speech using TTS (Text-to-Speech). This feature is helpful for a set of people who have low literacy levels, those who have an interest in learning a new language, and also for elderly people having low eyesight. The proposed method also helps in identifying a person's emotion based on the text and emojis sent during a conversation. The emotional intelligence of a person is identified using NRCLex (lexicon-based method) in our proposed solution. This feature is mainly helpful in fields like marketing, wherein, the customer support agent has a conversation with the customer in order to identify their customer satisfaction. The growing generation is much addicted to the social media networks like WhatsApp, Facebook, tweeter etc., With the help of emotion detection characteristic we can easily identify the public opinion regarding a particular issue, rate of stress & anxiety prevailing among the young generations. Also, the NLTK based method helps in removing the Stop words and help in identifying the Synonyms & Antonyms of a word which is a very useful feature for reading any document with correct vocabulary and understanding. The accuracy of this model is 98% approximately.

articleTitle: Currency Detection App for Blind People Using MIT App Inventor
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper helps the visually impaired people to identify the currency notes using an app built using MIT app inventor. The user has to press the shutter button in order to identify the amount of the currency being scanned. The output of the app is a voice command that will help the blind people to identify the amount. This paper makes use of the artificial intelligence tool to classify the image and gives the output. The artificial intelligence uses the image classifier to classify the image.Normally, the image classifier takes the input given the user and classifies the given input and gives the output.Here, the input given is the currency notes of different values so that the image classifier classifies the input and gives the output. This paper uses personal image classifier model to classify or detect the captured image.Here, the captured image in indian rupee note. This personal image classifier consists of four steps.

articleTitle: Cloud Assisted IOT Enabled Forest Fire Detection System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Forest fires tend to happen in wild areas as a result of human negligence and environmental change. They harm the environment and may result in the deaths of humans and wild animals. As a result, forest fires must be detected early in order to avoid further damage. Many existing systems, such as satellite networks, CCD cameras, wired systems, and Bluetooth technology, may provide a comprehensive view of the biosphere, but only after an extensive scan period. This method is ineffective because it only identifies forest fires after they have already started. The cloud assisted IoT enabled technique was proposed as an alternative to traditional forest fire detection methods. The Adafruit cloud server stores all of the real-time analysis values, which are collected with the help of the sensor nodes The Internet of Things is used for a range of functions, including habitat surveillance, intelligent systems, agricultural sectors, security and smart manufacturing. This proposed system consists of a system for measuring temperature, light intensity, and quality of air in order to avoid a disaster (forest fire) that would lead to a substantial reduction in the natural threads. Several tests were performed in this project to demonstrate the system's viability.

articleTitle: Advanced Control Strategies for the Grid Integration of Wind Energy System Employed with Battery Units
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: There is a global wide reception for the renewable energy sectors owing to the failure phase of conventional systems in the modern society. The concern may arise because of the growing demands and obviously the setbacks created by the conventional form of power generations. Among other form of non-conventional energy sources, wind technology receives a better acceptance next to the solar photovoltaic energy generation. Battery units (BUs) are considered to be the mains of the renewable power extraction due to the unreliability of resources and the similar design structure of the BUs are unsuitable for wide applications. This particular research certainly deals about the hybrid BU technology and enhancement of its relevant characteristics to be employed for grid integration of wind energy systems respectively. The bidirectional converter study is performed, alongside grid and source side converters with appropriate control strategies and their performances are analyzed in detail. Ultra capacitor studies are imposed to suppress the power fluctuations across the DC link and allowed momentary charging of BUs based on the requirements. The state of charging (SoC) of BUs is monitored and appropriate controllers are perhaps used to manage the generation and utilization. The idea pertaining to the discussions are executed through the PSCAD simulation platform and the results are validated.

articleTitle: Intelligent Sensor and IoT Based Vehicle Pollution Monitoring System with Alert
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Natural disasters are a growing issue these days. Vehicle, rail, and truck air pollution can cause respiratory diseases and asthma episodes. Transportation accounts for more than half of all carbon monoxide emissions in the atmosphere. Currently, when the RTO office issues the wellness certification, the vehicle's emissions are validated using pollution control stations located in particular urban areas. The health declarations for private autos are valid for a long time and must be updated at regular intervals after that. In the case of transportation vehicles, the health certification is granted for a long time and then expanded every year. We cannot distinguish outflows caused by this interaction since we presume the vehicle is static until FC. This project will be able to monitor and warn about air pollution on city streets by linking the Global System of Mobile Communications Network to the cloud, as well as track automobiles that emit discharges above a set edge. This also focuses on avoiding accidents caused by carbon monoxide gas produced by vehicles by installing a Gas sensor.

articleTitle: Interpretation and Analysis of Angular Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In today's world of rapidly evolving technologies and a heightened focus on customer satisfaction, it is crucial for numerous web application frameworks to undergo constant upkeep and update in order to meet the demands of the modern market. There are a plethora of web frameworks to choose from, and it's up to the developer to find one that works best for their project. The history, development, features, and implications of Angular, a web framework developed by Google that is widely used for Single Page Applications, are the subject of this study. Among the many popular frameworks used to create modern, single-page web applications, Angular's primary purpose is to facilitate the creation of dynamic views within the app itself. Rather than spending so much time wrangling with the underlying technology, developers should be able to focus on the user experience (such as HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript). Angular's out-of-the-box features are excellent, and it has the potential to make nontrivial jQuery-based projects much more robust while still being easy to maintain. This study discusses the various Angular versions that can be used for single-page front-end web development, and it provides guidance for developers selecting the best one to use.

articleTitle: Emoji Anticipation and Prediction Using Deep Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Emojis are tiny pictorial depictions of feelings or objects that are frequently used in text messaging to enhance intercultural dialogue. Emojis are increasingly being used by users of social media sites like Twitter and Instagram in their text messages to express broader emotions that are frequently challenging to express in words alone. Combining text and emojis to express emotion has become a crucial part of how people communicate in the twenty-first century. In order to ascertain the connection between these text messages and the emojis used in them, a problem statement has been developed. In this study, we offer a technique for anticipating several emojis for a given text-based tweet message. Three modules make up the suggested model. The given text data is preprocessed in the first module, the model on which the data is trained is in the second, and a multi-class classifier is used in the third module to predict the emojis that the given text would evoke. This proposed deep neural network model aims to understand the underlying semantics of a text sentence using natural language processing techniques in order to predict appropriate emojis. Experiments performed utilizing a sizable data collection of Twitter-sourced real-world emoji usage.

articleTitle: Cattle Tracking System Architecture Using LORA
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the last several years, India's cattle business has risen tremendously. The growing need for protection and security has made complete documentation of cattle breeding a legal requirement. Using RFID (radio frequency ID) as a regular monitoring system, we outlined a plan to monitor every step of the cattle feeding process in this article. Cattle can be recognized and monitored with the use of a comprehensive solution and an RFID management system. We can track and find cattle using this method in order to prevent them from being stolen or dispersed. LoRa wireless technology is used to transmit data on the location of live livestock to a central control center that is powered by Solar Photovoltaic Technology panels.

articleTitle: Hybridization of Supercapacitor and Battery for Fast Charging of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The number of electric vehicles (EVs) used for both private and public transportation has significantly increased during the previous years. The electrical system now faces enormous power demands, particularly where quick charging is necessary. We developed an innovative change in the existing infrastructure for rapid charging in EV based on super capacitors. This infrastructure will be included with a bank of supercapacitor which are directly supplied through the EV's plug in port and this bank will be used to charge the energy storage system (lithium-ion battery) in electric buses, we concentrate on public transport since they are directly associated with the public, where charging time is the biggest concern. A supercapacitor is a device for storing energy that is frequently subjected to short-duration, high-current charge and discharge cycles. So, here we are using a supercapacitor that charges and discharges in less time. The design of electric vehicle will remain the same, but we are adding a super capacitor bank inside the EV for charging the battery. The super capacitor is supplied from through the off-board charger with the plug-in configuration. The supercapacitor bank is then discharged through a buck converter in order to make the charge suitable for charging the Lithium-ion battery in EV. Since the ability of super capacitor to get charged is very fast and it takes only few seconds to get charged from the charging panel and the vehicle need not be intact with the connector in station for longer period of time and this super capacitor slowly charges the battery through the buck convertor thereby reducing the need of long hours to get charged. In order to increase the efficiency of longevity of battery to remain charged we have also made a little innovation in the EV's motor configuration, when the force given to accelerator is removed the inertia will create a reverse action and motor will try to act as generator which will not happen in usual EV but here we make use of a Traction inverter to trap the generator power to give back to the supercapacitor bank, thereby increasing the efficiency of charging and discharging of the super capacitor bank.

articleTitle: Doctor's Handwritten Prescription Recognition System In Multi-Language Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Doctors typically write in incomprehensible handwriting, making it difficult for both the general public and some pharmacists to understand the medications they have prescribed. It is not ideal for them to write the prescription quietly and methodically because they will be dealing with dozens of patients every day and will be swamped with work. As a result, their handwriting is illegible. This may result in reports or prescriptions consisting of short forms and cursive writing that a typical person or pharmacist won't be able to read properly, which will cause prescribed medications to be misspelled. However, some individuals are accustomed to writing prescriptions in regional languages because we all live in an area with a diversity of regional languages. It makes analyzing the content much more challenging. So, in this project, we'll use a recognition system to build a tool that can translate the handwriting of physicians in any language. This system will be made into an application which is fully autonomous in functioning. As the user uploads the prescription image the program will pre-process the image by performing image pre-processing, and word segmentations initially before processing the image for training. And it will be done for every language we require the model to detect. And as of the deduction model will be made using deep learning techniques including CNN, RNN, and LSTM, which are utilized to train the model. To match words from various languages that will be written in the system, Unicode will be used. Furthermore, fuzzy search and market basket analysis are employed to offer an end result that will be optimized from the pharmaceutical database and displayed to the user as a structured output.

articleTitle: IoT based Conveyor belt design for contact less courier service at front desk during pandemic
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: During pandemic different kind of virus is spread through contact. Exchange of different goods, documents and different components need to be transfer from one place to other place or country to country through courier / postal service. For the protection of front desk or office people from the pandemic, we can design a conveyor belt at front desk of courier offices. In this conveyor belt we can arrange barcode readers, microcontroller interface actuators, and GSM shields. Such that at front office employees need not to touch the objects. They generate a barcode for customer, customer need to place the barcode sheet on their consignment and keep on the conveyor belt. This conveyor belt will guide the consignment based on barcode reader and it can separate the consignments for local and international transfer. And any objection for the consignment an SMS will be sent to correspondent customer.

articleTitle: Gradient-Driven Texture-Normalized Liver Tumor Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Prior methods had trouble developing an effective segmentation framework model for detecting liver tumors from CT images, leading to subpar results in terms of both visual appeal and morphological accuracy. Scale and focus changes almost always have an effect on abnormal liver CT image sets, in contrast to statistical measures. As such, an effective ACM model is developed to partition the liver areas, accounting for boundary discontinuity and variations. Parametric in nature, the presented algorithms take advantage of initial parameter sets to achieve better results. In order to adapt to shifting liver boundaries and increase precision, we present a gradient-driven ROI model with automatic texture and shape feature extraction.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle for disaster response and relief operations: helping hands from air
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Fixed wing plane requires large area for take-off and also has long flying time; on the other hand, Quadcopter take-off area is small but lesser flying time. So we have designed a hybrid Vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) plane which can either land or take off vertically like a quadcopter as well as long endurance of fixed wing has been put together while eliminating the disadvantage of both quadcopters and fixed wing planes. This will help to adopt superior flying qualities to the hybrid vertical take-off and landing plane. This paper presents the design and working of a hybrid unmanned aerial vehicle (UAVs) which can run at its robust speed for a long distance and with the help of the solar panel fitted on its upper body, it can recharge its battery while flying. It can also be used at longer distance with the help of 4G module fitted in it and also get footage of that area with help of camera on it. These are the unique features of our UAV which made it different from other hybrid UAVs. In this paper, a prototype of aerial vehicle is presented and some plans for future aerial vehicles are also been discussed.

articleTitle: Automatic Optimized Voice Based Gender Identification for Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In Today's world ecommerce and advertisements sectors becomes very crucial also unavoidable in this scenario identifying gender of a person is important to make ourselves safe and secure. This project identifies gender of a person, by using features of their voice and processing these features using various machine learning algorithms. For this purpose four different types of popular classifiers were used and showed their accuracy. Popular classifiers used here is Random forest MLP neural network, CHAID decision tree and XGBOOST using these classifiers the voice can be classified as male or female. Using XGBOOST classifier the accuracy attained is 99.621 which is highest accuracy when compared to other classifiers.

articleTitle: Aerodynamic Analysis of Supersonic Flow through a Dual Bell Nozzle using CFD
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: One of the most promising nozzle jet concepts is the dual-bell nozzle, which is an altitude adaptive nozzle. Recently, the concept of altitude-adaptive rocket nozzles has gained prominence and piqued the curiosity of space explorers. Dual-bell nozzles have two bells separated by an inflection point as its primary characteristic. The numerical investigation is carried out to find the Mach number, flow characteristics, and temperature change over time through three differently designed dual bell nozzles. The analysis is done on three bells with constant pressure and different areas with the second bell so as to give more velocity. Increasing and decreasing the area of the extended nozzle, pressure is controlled. Similarly, increasing of the pressure, the velocity gets decreased. The three dual bells are designed using SOLIDWORKS and analysis of the nozzle geometries are carried out using commercial code, ANSYS Fluent 2020. K-epsilon turbulence model is used for the simulation. A total of 50000 iterations are done with hybrid initialization. The current study demonstrates that decreasing area of dual bell nozzle gives more thrust.

articleTitle: Industrial Environmental Monitoring and Rectifying System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The creation of embedded systems has shown to be a dependable method for keeping track of and improving the industrial environment. The project's aim is to create a structure that can be applied globally at any size to monitor the environmental factors, correct errors, and stop impending accidents in the workplace. Remote monitoring of factors like temperature, humidity, CO2 levels, and many more is now possible because to the development of tiny sensor devices and wireless technology. The main board will be an Arduino, and sensors will gather all of the real-time environmental data. This real-time data will be communicated via IoT (Node MCU) to the web server, where it can be seen on a webpage. This real-time data can also be viewed in the display also. Users can ingress this data from anywhere through the Internet. Motors and drivers are used to rectify and prevent accident that is about to occur in the industry. This proposed system will serve to be an important part in industrial development.

articleTitle: Exploration and Aspects on Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) is a collaborative experience of a physical world environment along with 3D virtual objects. Augmented Reality allows the user to interact with the virtual objects created in the real world. A device must be capable of calculating the position and orientation of virtual objects with respect to other physical objects for displaying AR content. This is one of the emerging technologies in today's world. Augmented Reality has become popular in various domains. Various applications of AR include prototyping, Sales and marketing, Gaming, health care, etc. A device that generates AR will combine the real world and virtual objects and provide concluded meanings for the user. The combination of AR with other technologies such as Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, IoT, Natural Language Processing takes the technology to another level. The evolution of mobile apps helped in the spread of AR among people. The main objective of this paper is to review various aspects of Augmented Reality, its applications along with advantages and challenges faced by it.

articleTitle: Smart Wearable for Pulmonary Fibrosis Patient Monitoring with Oxygen Saturation Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This study focuses on measuring the oxygen saturation level in a patient with pulmonary fibrosis. A lung condition known as pulmonary fibrosis develops when lung tissue is injured and scarred. Lung function is made more difficult by this stiffand thicker tissue. This project is proposed to sense the oxygen level using oxidation sensor and body temperature by temperature sensor of the patient. The sensed values are recorded, and data are pushed to the transport layer. Using a Wi-Fi module, the captured data is sent to the cloud server. The data is fetched from the application layer through web application using J avaScript. Therefore a web application is developed in this paper. The data collected from the application layer is transmitted to a live analysis to monitor and check the condition of pulmonary fibrosis with a graphical analysis of their oxidation level and body temperature with saturation. Machine learning algorithms are applied to predict the oxygen saturation of a patient. Therefore, it is suggested in this study that doctors avoid direct contact with patients to stop the spread of the illness and to effectively monitor the oxygen saturation level of each patient.

articleTitle: Intelligent Wireless Charging Station for EVs with Integrated PV Power Grid System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The significant developments in vehicle and grid technologies have plunged the emission of greenhouse gasses like CO2 particulate matter (PMX) Sulphur dioxide. In this paper a wireless charging station based on WPT is suggested to revive the battery of electric vehicles. Generally, wireless charging is used for high-power applications to integrate with the grid. Wireless power transfer (WPT) is a fascinating methodology that has its own merits that include contact less power transfer, minimal power loss, lower transmission and distribution cost and power can be transmitted anywhere which is not possible in wired transmission. Wireless or cordless charging or inductive charging with the near-field concept is an enhanced version of wireless mobile phone charging technique. This EVs for charging easily in the charging station anywhere. The charging station is connected to the primary winding and E vehicle with a secondary wireless transmission. Additionally, a GSM module is introduced in this paper that communicates to the end user whenever the vehicle is charging.

articleTitle: Atmospheric Air Condensation for Irrigation by the application of Peltier effect using Solar energy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper presents the method to irrigate agricultural land by condensation of the atmospheric air using Peltier effect. It is been achieved by making use of a Peltier element. Due to the passage of electric current, the two sides of the element generate opposite temperature zones. This can be capitalized to cool down water and make it flow through a pipe. Water droplets that form on the outer surface of the pipe fall on the soil and eventually help in irrigation. This approach is different from other methods in the sense that it can be used in arid as well as coastal regions. It is installed independent from water and electricity grids. This system aims to reduce farmer dependency on rains for irrigation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Vehicle to Grid (V2G) Integration in Renewable based Micro grid
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper discusses the function of the vehicle-to-grid (V2G) connection in the frequency control of renewable-based micro-grids. The micro-grid is fueled by sporadic wind and solar photovoltaic sources, a diesel generator that serves as a backup power source, as well as loads from homes and businesses. Modeling and simulating the entire system is done in the MATLAB/Simulink environment. Many different kinds of vehicle profiles are considered for simulation purposes. The following operational scenarios are simulated: partial shading of solar photovoltaic panels; wind farm power ceasing due to high wind speeds; and a sudden change in load demand. Results from simulations illustrate the value of V2G inclusion in power regulation and grid frequency regulation under challenging circumstances.

Author Keywords: Vehicle to Grid and Grid integration

articleTitle: Real Time Pervasive Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Monitoring our health is crucial for keeping our heart healthy. This paper discusses the importance of heart rate monitoring in preserving cardiovascular health. The monitoring device must be suitable enough to handle this situation because the maximum and minimum heart rate ranges vary among people of different ages. The proposed IoT enabled health monitoring system contains a pulse sensor which is connected with Node MCU module for tracking the patient's heart rate. Additionally, an auxiliary alert system is provided, and it is activated if the heartbeat falls or rises. The patient's health is continuously monitored since, a server keeps receiving the patient's heartbeat by HTTP protocol. Also the patients are connected via android by the usage of a transportable Wi-Fi device.

articleTitle: Smart Lane Detection Using Open CV And Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Lane detection has become popular in real time vehicular lane detection. The Lane detection plays a major role in Driver Assistance System. Our paper aims to improve results of lane detection by using various algorithms which reduce noise visibility, picture quality, etc. This will be helpful in improving the performance of existing algorithm for lane detection. In case if any noise persists in the form of fog or any type of obstacle such as dust, shadow, puddles, oil stains and tyre skid marks in the road image, the existing methods fails to give efficient results. So, the overall goal of this paper is to evaluate the gaps in the existing methodology and to give suitable solution for the same. In this paper we have developed a Entropy based fusion model (EBFM), simple method and to improve the results of lane detection and object detection based on Arduino. In Heuristic method, clustering methodology is used to group the detected points and a best fit line in the mean square sense to detect the lanes.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Performance IoT based Healthcare and Medical Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In terms of the utilisation of advanced healthcare and health ware systems, the Indian healthcare environment has been gradually evolving. Accelerate the use of healthware and healthcare systems in response to recent environmental circumstances and the rising rate of health concerns. The shortage of medical experts, hospitals, poor access to drugs, and the absence of quality healthcare in remote and rural areas are all impeding the expansion of India's healthcare systems. By offering a competent, integrated, well-connected, patient-centred system, the Internet of Things (IoT) can play a critical role in improving India's dismal healthcare system.

articleTitle: Improving Torque in PMSM by Introducing Flux Barrier
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The PMSM is widely used in industrial applications. There are two kinds of PMSM: interior PMSM, and surface-mounted PMSM. I have considered myself an interior PMSM in my research. IPMSMs are typically used in electrical vehicles, and the flux barrier within the rotor produces a major issue with motor torque performance. According to this research paper, flux barriers are used on the rotor side of PMSM motors in order to improve torque performance and reduce cogging torque. I used the same motor reference in my previous research to further reduce cogging torque and increase motor performance torque this time. FEA (finite element analysis) computations are performed using the MAGNET software (Infolityca) & motorcad

articleTitle: Performance Investigation of 800nm and 1000nm wavelength in an Optical Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Optical Wireless Communication became center of attraction since last two decades as it does not have any assigned protocol to be used its spectrum and it is unaffected by Electromagnetic interferences, higher bandwidth, high immunity, enhanced interconnectivity and enabling Inter satellite links between LEO-GEO. In general it overcome the limitations of conventional Radio frequency technologies. As Laser didoes providing operating wavelength of 800nm to 1550 nm are preferred for ISL links. In this paper we investigated the performance of 800nm and 1000nm wavelength signal on Optical Wireless channel with the range of 1200Km and important receiver parameters like Quality factor, Bit Error rate, Optical Signal Noise ratio analyzed. Q-factor variation with respect to Range and output signal power plotted for different wavelengths mentioned and it is promising for future enhancements. It has predicted that high Q-factor achieved for lower wavelength range. Without considering various signal attenuation significantly, it is proved that when Optical wavelength range decreased Optical Signal to noise ratio increased and showed good amount of Quality factor values for short ranges.

articleTitle: Automatic Solar Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: solar energy has become an increasingly important and popular renewable energy source. By using a solar tracking system, we can produce an abundance of energy and improve the efficiency of solar panels. The solar panel's efficiency lies in its perpendicular proportionality with the sun's rays. Although cheaper options are also available, its installation charge is high. A prototype solar panel is discussed in this paper based on the sun's rays as the reason for its design and construction. Arduino is used as the main control circuit. As a result of the programming of this device, the LDR sensor, when it detects sun rays, will provide direction to the Servo Motor in order to move the solar panel. Consequently, the solar panel is positioned so that it can receive the maximum amount of sunlight.

articleTitle: Analysis of Distinctive DC-DC Power Converters for an Enabled Freestanding Solar Water Pump
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The present study, different high-frequency power conversion techniques to improve the water pump with solar energy. The potential power of the solar irradiation is maximized using the Maximum Power Point Tracking management method. Due to their frequent distance from the village, fields in rural locations will be challenging to link to the grid. Therefore, pumps and other needs on the fields can be supported by freestanding PV systems. It is necessary to choose the best DC-DC converter for a pumping requirement. This article analyses the performance of a number of power converters including the CUK, SEPIC, Boost, Buck Boost, using MPPT techniques including Firefly, Grey Wolf, and cat swarm optimization.

articleTitle: Analysis and Hardware Implementation of a Single Inductor Dual Input Single Output DC-DC Converter for Microgrid Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Integration of multiple sources to meet load requirements increases the reliability of the drive along with reducing the dependency on a single source. The application of PV sources in rural households is a conventional technique in the current scenario. The introduction of a multiple sources fed power converter-based power supply is a step further in the domain of distributed generation when a microgrid requires cost efficiency and minimal complexity. This paper proposes and analyses a converter application fed by dual sources and delivering a single output. Simulations and hardware implementation of the converter confirm the operation. Implementation of the proposed schematic in rural micro grids will contribute to self-sufficiency in the energy sector.

articleTitle: An Extensive Study of Cervical Cancer Detection Methods Using Machine and Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In this work, various computer-aided methods for cervical cancer screening are examined in-depth with examples. The cervical cancer can be detected using either cervical images or Pap smear cells images. Both are important to detect the cervical cancers in women patients. The several machine learning and deep learning models for detecting cervical cancer in Pap smear cell images as well as cervical images are covered in detail. The simulation study is used to evaluate the benefits and drawbacks of each cervical cancer screening method.

articleTitle: Social Media Personal Event Notifier Using NLP and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Social media apps have become very promising and omnipresent in daily life. Most social media apps are used to deliver vital information to those nearby and far away. As our lives become more hectic, many of us strive to limit our usage of social media apps because they are too addictive, and the majority of us have gotten preoccupied with our daily lives. Because of this, we frequently overlook crucial information, such as invitations to weddings, interviews, birthday parties, etc, or find ourselves unable to attend the event. In most cases, this happens because users are more likely to discover the invitation or information only before the event, giving them little time to prepare. To solve this issue, in this study, we created a system that will collect Social media chat and filter it using Natural Language Processing (NLP) methods like Tokenization, Stop Words Removal, Lemmatization, Segmentation, and Named Entity Recognition (NER). Also, Machine Learning Algorithms such as K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) Algorithm are implemented to prioritize the received invitation and to sort the level of priority. Finally, a customized notification will be delivered to the users where they acknowledge the upcoming event. So the chances of missing the event are less or can be planned.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Autonomous Water Tank Cleaning robot in Gazebo
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Designed to address the drawbacks of traditional water storage tank cleaning procedures, a new robot system is described in this paper for performing cleaning work instead of manual cleaning which is characteristic of low efficiency, low safety, long time, and water pollution problems. In this paper, we have described a robot system that can clean both the floor and walls of the water tank. The robot is designed in Fusion 360, and it is simulated in Gazebo by creating an environment of a water tank. For autonomous functionality, programs written in Robot Operating System (ROS) are employed.

articleTitle: Automatic Intelligent Model for Lung Tumor Detection using Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The rising mortality toll from tumor is indicative of a growing global health crisis. To put it simply, a tumor is an unnatural proliferation of abnormal cells that invades healthy cells. Lung tumor (LT) cause cellular imbalances that negatively impact lung function. In this era, LT has been and will continue to be the leading cause of mortality owing to tumor. Early LT prediction is crucial, especially in densely populated and low-income nations. Standard clinical techniques, such as blood tests and other medicines, are used by specialists. Using recent advances in Deep Learning (DL), it is possible to build an environmentally friendly prototype system for the prediction of LT. The goal of this study is to use DL to automate the process of detecting LT. Starting with data collecting and ending with model validation, this study's pipeline depicts the steps taken in the research process. Pre-processing steps like reshaping and resizing the data, building a DL model like a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and a Combined Convolutional Neural Network and Long-Short Term Memory (CNN-LSTM), training and validating the model comes in between the data collection and model validation stages. The experimental findings indicates that the CNN-LSTM is effective for LT prediction, with accuracy and loss of 98.12% and 1.87%, respectively.

articleTitle: Advanced Car Parking System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The world's population is rising daily, while the use of cars is metro expanding and this leads to the cities becoming more crowded. So car parking management is one of the main challenges for cities. In the past few years, a lot of research was conducted on how to improve the parking system and this attracted lots of researchers to research and release their unique ideas to improve the parking system to the current needs. The main problem of the current parking system is finding a particular vacant parking space in the largest parking area. As a result, this research introduced an “Advanced car parking system” that uses an Arduino Uno and mobile applications via the Internet of Things (IoT). This system aids drivers in locating and parking their vehicles in specific vacant spaces. Even before entering the parking area, the drivers can easily identify if any parking slot is available or not.

articleTitle: Voice Based Motile Video Surveillance System with ViolenceDetection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The consequences of lack of surveillance are horrendous, thus the need for surveillance is at its high spot. Monitoring and surveillance systems could not be extensively used as complexity exists in fitting CCTV surveillance camera at some locus and the prevailing surveillance systems requisites human assistance for recognizing illicit activities, consequently the crime rate goes on increasing. In order to wane the crime rate, the introduced system integrated with camera and the global system for mobile communications (GSM), rove around the environment discerning the illicit activities by implementing the computer vision technology and provides warning signal over a SMS. The system comprises of a transmitter and a receiver module, the data transmission between these modules is governed by LoRa. The proposed system is also implanted with PIR sensor and the global positioning system (GPS).

articleTitle: Development Testing and validation of Laboratory model for performance analysis of transmission line
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The power system at present provides less efficient power, so to improve the reliability and very efficiency of the overall power system, the fully generated power from the generating unit must be delivered to the utility. This can be achieved by improving the system by other means such as power factor correction, series, and shunt compensations, and reducing the Ferranti effect in the overall transmission system. The losses that occur from the transmission system as heat, losses due to the type of conductor, external parameters, and surge of voltages due to the Ferranti effect. In this work, attempt is made to design and develop a laboratory prototype of the transmission line. Performance analysis of the proposed prototype has been done under different load conditions.

articleTitle: Smart Railcar Immobilizer and Accident Alert System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper is newly invented for the solution of prevention of consecutive accidents happening in Railways. The embedded project ensures a fully automated system that provides unauthorized access of trains and running away from stable rake is immobilized by the train immobilizer. This Train Immobilizer consists of three levels of security- RFID detection, Biometric Sensing and typing password. The consecutive accidents are prevented by the accident alerter that protects the accident spot in case of any train accident by sending out a RF message to 2 kilometer radius which is sensed by the approaching train and reduces the speed thus avoiding the collision between the trains. Further the speed of the approaching train is reduced automatically thus providing successive collisions. TIAA (TRAIN IMMOBILIZER AND ACCIDENT ALERTER) reduces the human dependency thus enabling a safe and secure system. With the help of GPS and GSM module, Railcar is tracked and detected for any emergency purpose.

articleTitle: Secured agriculture crop monitoring using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: An efficient and agriculture web-enabled system is proposed to develop the agriculture sector by providing appropriate information to its users (Farmers) through a forum-based model and also facilitate E-commerce within the system. The expert solutions often reach the farmers too late which is pointless. Most farmers don't know the price at which the product would be sold to the consumer. It is the intermediaries who determine the final price of the products and hence they are not sure of their actual revenue. We develop this web application to provide fast, accurate, easy-to-use, and inexpensive solutions to farmers and also help the users to sell and buy products within the system easily at the desired price.

articleTitle: Intelligent Device for Monitoring the Dementia Patients in Real Time using IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Health care can only be partially recreated in a centralized system. It's a complicated web of relationships and interactions, and those are best understood from the perspective of the patient. The patient is the person who is trying to get better, not the person who is trying to provide care. That means that health care needs to be decentralized, so it's in the hands of the people who understand the patient's needs best. In our suggested wearable gadget, we employ a highly precise GPS module that can identify a person's location either inside or outside a building and relay it to a computer. When the elderly person leaves the region defined by the sensor, the sensor immediately provides the position of the wandering old person. The computer notifies the caregiver via the web page notice. In our suggested project, we will construct a wearable gadget that is low in cost, high in efficiency, energy efficient, and simple to use.

articleTitle: Controller optimization for a single tank liquid level system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The prime motto of process control is to uphold a process at the preferred operating states safely and proficiently and also meeting out the environmental and product quality standards. The term “process” denotes an arrangement or a facility that needs to be regulated. It could be a chemical process like digesters, CSTR, thermal mixers, reactors, liquid level controlled feed water tanks etc., Kkeeping track of certain system throughput variables, such as heating rate, pressure gradient, and tank level, etc., is crucial if the plant is to be automated. Depending on the application selected, it is possible for the controlled technique to be incremental or sustained.. In this study, a typical first order tank is taken into account. A controller's design is extremely complex because it calls for nonlinear variations in the parameters. Process control techniques like feedback, feed forward, ratio control are frequently used. The level of the tank is kept close to the set point value using a conventional PID controller. The transfer function model is gleaned from the fundamental concepts.. The tuning methodology adopted are Ziegler -Nichols tuning and Genetic algorithm based method. Time domain quality factors like peak response, rise time, and settling time are determined and compared. It is proven that GA tuned controller optimises the settling of the level of the fluid in the tank

articleTitle: IoT - Traffic Video Surveillance System for Weapon Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the previous few years, multimedia traffic has significantly increased. The Internet of Things (IoT) introduces new traffic and applications. SDNs improve network administration. When used in conjunction with SDN, artificial intelligence (AI) can offer solutions to network issues based on approaches for classification and estimation. In this study, we investigate how to enable delay-sensitive applications in IoT contexts by integrating deep learning techniques with Software-Defined Network (SDN) architecture. As a case study, real-time video surveillance applications serve as the basis for the construction and testing of a large number of deep learning-based models for weapon detection. To aid in the early detection and prevention of various crimes, as well as to reduce the bandwidth requirements by offloading the communication network from massive traffic transmission using the fuzzy technique, The best deep learning model is utilized by a proposed artificial intelligence model at the edge that is located in order to extract the first discovered video frames that contain weapons in order to ensure prompt transmission of this information to law enforcement. In other words, the best deep learning model is used to extract the first discovered video frames containing weapons for prompt transmission to law enforcement. Results indicate that the network may minimize jitter by up to 80% on average and losses by about 4% by taking certain actions.

Author Keywords: SDN and AI with Fuzzy technique

articleTitle: Precised and Efficient Mobile Solar Tracking System with amicable power consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In recent days, solar energy utilization is becoming more over whelming in the generation of power. The power production is not efficient to meet the required standards. It is essential to improve the efficiency of PV solar modules using low power consuming solar tracking systems. This paper aims in designing a solar tracking system using pressurized nitrogen gas and programmable logic controller to control the motion of dual axis solar tracking surfaces. The tracking direction is based on the voltage differences of four middle edged differential amplifiers of the solar panel which is fed to the comparator and programmable logic controller. Solenoid valves are used to control the axis of the solar panel in that specified direction. This pressurized air controlled solar tracking system consumes very less power than the conventional method.

articleTitle: Electronic Wheelchair With Eye Motion Control For Physically Hectic People
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A new process is executed for the eye control based independent and Cost-efficient system. The plan of eye movement controlled electronic wheelchair is to get rid of necessity of the help needed for the disabled person. In order to help the differently abled people, numerous types of interfaces have been advanced for electric wheelchair control such as joysticks controlled, head movement controlled, voice controlled etc., many people with disabilities may find it difficult to operate the chair using the above-mentioned interfaces. It is an idea to make lives of the disabled people easier i.e., independent, which will thereby increase their confidence to move from one place to another. The web camera mounted in front of the user will capture the image of the eye movement. The eye movements as prepared using python open CV and the command are sent to the Node MCUs which is programmed using Arduino IDE, which controls the direction of the wheelchair. Therefore, we have achieved more than 94 % of accuracy in determining the eye direction.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of 40m band LSB Mode Home Brew HAM Radio for Emergency Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper describes an enhanced crowd sourcing that may be the only alternative when everything else fails in a disaster. In situations of worse, emergency disasters, amateur radiotelegraph often placed as a means of emergency critical communication methodology when communication cable links, cellular gadgets and other kinds of traditional mode of communication methodology fails. Diverse regular marketable modes, Amateur radio communication usually unconstrained of terrestrial disaster facilities that can fails. It is scattered throughout a community without “choke points” such as cellular telephony area that can be overloaded. Any transmission communication capable of transmitting can be used to make a crisis radio call. The problem in using just any transmitter is that no one may be listening at the time of seeking help or they may be out of range of the transmitter, thus the more popular emergency communications devices and services that can be monitored is amateur radio also called “ham radio.” Anyone of any age can become a licensed “ham” radio operator as most ham radio operators have access to communications, where cell phones and the Internet no longer work.

articleTitle: Numerical Investigation on Enhanced Aerodynamic Performance of a Bus using Vortex Generators - Air Tab and Shark Fin
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: 3D flow structures around bus models are computationally analyzed to understand the influence of vortex generator on bus body aerodynamics. The aerodynamics of a vehicle are extremely important since they influence the vehicle's overall performance. As the vehicle is moving on the road, various forces act on an automobile, such as drag and lift force, is a part of vehicle aerodynamics research. One of the primary causes of aerodynamic drag for automobiles is the flow separation at the vehicle's rear end. It is feasible to improve fuel economy by lowering the drag force. This research uses five identical bus models, four with VGs and one without. The purpose is to examine the effects of two types of vortex generators (Air-tab and Shark-fin) in terms of drag coefficient (C<inf>d</inf>) and flow pattern developments by mounting the VGs at the rear end of the bus. The flow around the vehicle is considered to be incompressible. It is calculated using the incompressible Reynolds Navier-Stokes equations and k-ε turbulence model. Base Bus model, bus with top Shark-fin VG, bus with top Air-tab VG, bus with Shark-fin VG on 3 sides, bus with Air-tab VG on 3 sides. During the analysis, the bus is subjected to various inlet velocity ranges, ranging from 25m/s to 50 m/s, with an interval of 5m/s. The simulation results show a 7.898% reduction in coefficient of drag (C<inf>d</inf>) from the bus model with Air tab vortex generators on 3 sides at 25 m/s.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Controlled Wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper outlines a method for directing wheelchair movement through hand gestures. The wheelchair is made in such a way that any individual may control it with ease if they just move their wrist. The hand movements are recognized by using hand gesture recognition algorithm. It recognizes five different hand movements like forward, reverse, left, right and stop. It does not involve complex computing system which is quite challenging for the elderly people. This design also has GPS features to track location of the wheelchair from anywhere in the world. It is also connected by using Bluetooth technology which helps the people to control through assisting people.

articleTitle: Comparison and Analysis of Lift Converters Using Incremental Conductance MPPT for Electric vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This article presents the comparison of self lift positive output(P/O) and negative output(N/O) Luo converters incorporating Inc Cond MPPT intended for PV applications. The fundamental circuit expressions of a Photovoltaic cell is used to model a photo voltaic panel. The sun temperature and insolation impacts the MPP of a solar panel. The MPP from the solar panel is attained by using IncCond algorithm. The self lift luo converters that are used regulates the panel unregulated by reducing the current and voltage ripple. In comparison to the traditional converter, components stress is lesser in self lift Luo converters. Simulation is done by Matlab/Simulink.

Author Keywords: self lift P/O luoconverter and self lift N/O luo converter

articleTitle: Image Forgery Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Imaging technology has made tremendous progress in recent years, and digital images can now be captured by a variety of handheld devices such as mobile phones, wearables, tabs, and camcorders. These images are shared daily on social networks. Meanwhile, photo-editing software tools are making a comeback from the dawn of social networking, and filtering is just a few clicks away from your smart phone. These latest advances in image editing tools have eroded trust in digital images and cast doubt on their integrity and authenticity. Here, we use a machine learning algorithm (SVM) to effectively detect if an image has been manipulated and block users who try to upload altered images.

Author Keywords: Anti-Forensic Contrast-Enhanced Detector (AFCED) and Source Camera Identifier (SCI)

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Linear Taper Slot Antenna for Multiband Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Small, high-gain antennas have been in demand due to the proliferation of wireless technology over the past decade. For some uses, a high gain is preferable, while for others, a high return loss is required. Using multiband frequencies, a single Microstrip patch antenna can support all of these uses. For optimal performance and low return loss, a Linear Tapered Slot Antenna constructed from FR4 and fed by coaxial cable is required for this endeavor. At MmW frequencies, increasing channel capacity and decreasing inter-user interference calls for a directional antenna with a high gain. The proposed antenna is 38mm * 50mm in size and has a return loss of −16.03dB at 8.77GHz, 10.86dB at 9.55GHz, 7.68dB at 11.3GHz, −24.93dB at 14.32GHz, and −20.98dB at 16.13GHz. The proposed antenna was developed and tested with HFSS software, and it operates effectively in the C-band, X-band, and Ku-band for wireless communication. The outcome demonstrates the high degree of concordance between simulation and measurement.

articleTitle: An Improved Internet of Things Based Accident Detection System Using Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Despite our commitment and endeavors, vehicle accidents remain one of the biggest causes of death, disability, and hospitalization in the country. India is top among all 199 nations in terms of traffic-related deaths, accounting for over 11% of all accident-related deaths worldwide. Road Accidents also constitute over 13% of the total deaths in India in the past year. The major cause for deaths is the time it takes for informing about the accidents to ambulance, hospitals and to police. On the other hand, finding the location of the accident is a big challenge for ambulances and police, causing many deaths. In the Accident Detection System, the accident is detected automatically by the use of different sensors and it is informed to the ambulance and various other services through a Mobile Application along with the accident's GPS Location. The system is thus useful as a quick response to the accidents and may considerably reduce the death rates.

articleTitle: Smart Wearable Wristband for Patients' Health Monitoring System through IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In today's modern world, technology takes part an important role in the medical field. It is must necessary to monitor the patient's health continuously after the operation of the patient. In the healthcare field Internet of Things (IoT) plays the main roleinmonitoring health with lots of applications. To monitor the health parameters of the patient, the smart wearable wristband monitoring system is implemented by using the IoT domain. In this article, the NodeMCU microcontroller act as a gateway between the hardware devices and the software. The parameters to be measured from the patient's body are temperature, heart rate, glucose level, oxygen level, and Blood Pressure (BP). These parameters are measured by using the sensors. The sensors are interfaced with the microcontroller. Then the microcontroller sends the data from the sensors to the cloud. The cloud will analyse the data from the normal values given in the microcontroller. If any of the parameter's data from the sensor are measured as abnormal values, the cloud will send the alert message and the location of the patient to the patient's relatives, to the doctor who is attending that patient, and to the patients' mobile via Global System for Mobile communication (GSM), and Global Positioning System (GPS) for location.

articleTitle: PIR Motion Capture Security System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A PIR-based security system that reduces energy use and recording system memory requirements has been proposed. a warm-blooded moving thing within the area of passive infrared radiation (PIR) sensor's detecting range changes the infrared radiation it emits. The voltages produced, which were amplified and utilized to switch on the lighting system and webcam through the relay, will alter by the variation in infrared radiation. To record and capture video while the webcam is activated, software was created and installed on the computer. The webcam and lighting system are activated by the PIR sensor when an intruder enters its detection range. The software recognizes the webcam connection and. starts to capture and store the video. When the intruder exits the range of detection of the sensor, the webcam, and the light turn OFF. The procedure is repeated by the program. Only turning on the lamp and webcam when an item is detected by PIR sensors, reduces both power usage and the amount of memory used by the recording system. To save memory, The device only begins recording after the webcam is switched ON.

articleTitle: NEMO-SOS- A Future Trends in Smart Accident Alert Application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: NEMO is a smartphone SOS alert app that aims to enhance SOS functionality. In the event of a critical event, every minute of delay could put lives in jeopardy. The need for an infallible SOS (Self Organizing Security) notice system and a quicker, more reliable technique to recognise these events gave rise to our project NEMO. The software was developed as a mobile application as it uses the gyroscope and accelerometer of the device to identify accidents and provide alert messages. Nowadays, we carry our smartphones with us wherever we go, which advantages the SOS feature. The programme was made with the help of Kotlin, Java, and <tex>$\mathrm{C}++$</tex>. Sensors that track motion, orientation, and numerous environmental factors are typically included into Android-powered devices. These sensors are helpful for detecting the movement, location, or environmental changes of three-dimensional devices since they can provide raw data with precision and accuracy. They get their information using direct environmental sensing, such as acceleration, the strength of the geomagnetic field, or angular change. By utilising the Android sensor framework, we are able to gain access to these sensors and acquire the raw sensor data. The most recent location of the user's device may be requested by our app using the location APIs made available by the Google Play services. Then, our offering of Emergency SMS alert service satisfies the SOS alert application. To manage user data, we employ the Firebase Cloud. We develop an optimised application using best practises.

articleTitle: Voice-Activated Wireless Control System for Home Automation Using 2.4GHZ WiFi
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Home automation is a technology-based system that controls all of the electrical gadgets in a home. People nowadays seek to make their homes more modish and more functional. Our main focus of the project is to make it affordable with a low-cost design, a user-friendly interface, and simple installation in a house. Proposed system can be controlled using an IR remote, Bluetooth technology, switches, Wi-fi, a mobile application, and Alexa. It's simple to set up in both current systems and freshly furnished homes, and we can build the control system to meet our individual needs. Users would be able to control their household electrical appliances remotely using voice-based speech recognition with the proposed technology. The product is put through a real-world quality test by turning on and off the appliances over 1,000 times to ensure that they are effective and helpful. Overall our product will be cost-effective, save energy and time, and provide a better quality of service to all types of people.

articleTitle: Arduino Based Smart Aiding System for Visually Challenged People
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Obstacle detection is one of the critical worries for a totally or a partially blind individual. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), around three crore human beings are absolutely blind and out of it two crores eighty-five lakh people are with vision problems. The proposed work describes smart stick which is based totally on ultrasonic and infrared sensors. The controller that is used in this project is Arduino Nano. In the proposed work, a clever manual blind stick is used for detecting any obstruction, find corners or even allow the user to find the stick if anyhow it is missed anywhere. The aiding device is designed with a goal to figure out an unusual problem faced via the blind human beings on the same time as using conventional sticks. With the electronics embed inside the stick, it is developed to be a smart stick. This device is expected to be supporting medium for the blind people. The smart stick is employed with sensors for impediment detection. The ultimate goal of the proposed work is to discover any obstacle close by and notify the person of course of that obstacle, and even give warning message to the user, thereby allowing the user to decide the corrective route to move.

articleTitle: Intimation of Accident Zone Location
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the current world, the usage of vehicles is increasing, so the number of accidents also increases which causes massive loss of lives. The safety of the people is most important. The lack of proper emergency facilities may lead to the loss of many life. This paper may give an optimum solution to this problem.
