articleTitle: Computational Investigation of Jet Mixing Enhancement by C-D Nozzle using Triangular Tabs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This computational study deals with the flow development, jet characteristic decay and mixing enhancement of jet from a C-D nozzle with triangular tab and without tab at the nozzle outlet with design Mach number of 1.8. The triangular tabs are placed opposed to each other at the nozzle outlet. The effect of the tabs on mixing and jet decay characteristics has been investigated. The C-D nozzle and the triangular tab are designed in design modeler and the simulation is done using ANSYS Fluent. The analysis is also done for under expanded and overexpanded conditions in both the cases with nozzle pressure ratio (NPR) 4 and 7.2. The comparison is made between the jets from nozzle without tab and nozzle with triangular tab using Mach number and pressure contour plots. A series of shock cells is observed clearly in two cases. The shock cell length and shock strength decrease for the jet at the presence of triangular tab. This results in a quicker decay of the jet in nozzle with tab case. The comparison between the both cases shows that the C-D nozzle with tab at the nozzle exit is recognized to be the superior mixing promoter compared to nozzle without tab.

articleTitle: Enhanced Home Automation and Security Using IoT Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Millions of disparate devices must be seamlessly connected in order for the Internet of Things (IoT) idea to work. Implementing an The IoT-based smart home has attracted a great deal of attention has developed into an important area of study in the modern day. “Home automation” refers to the automatic and computerised control of appliances, activities, and aspects of the home. Simply said, it means you may easily manage the utilities and operations of your home over the Internet, simplifying and securing daily tasks while also reducing household expenses. The smart home idea improves the comfort and convenience of our lives with the help of IoT. The two key issues in the current smart home environment are automation and security. Sensors that can keep an eye on variations in the amount of daylight, the temperature, or motion detection can be used. These (and other) parameters may then be customised by home automation systems to suit your preferences. In this paper, the above problem is investigated using hardware that is simple, inexpensive, and easily available. Despite the hardware's modest cost, its capabilities should not be overlooked. This system can be incredibly powerful and secure if the correct tools are used. In this paper, the viability of such a setup is assessed for everyday usage and was found to be quite effective.

articleTitle: IoT based Energy Assistive Meter to Analyse the Electricity usage in Commercial and Household uses via Wirelessly in a Cloud Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: An electric instrument known as an energy metre can be used to measure energy use. The cost and frequency of power use are communicated to the consumer in order to avoid large bill utilization. The energy metre displays the number of units utilized and transmits the data to both the client and the electrical board, which aids in the reduction of man-power. The user may monitor their power use from any location and at any time. In this project, we will build our own IoT-based electricity energy metre with the ESP32 and monitor data using the Blynk App. With today's technology, you must go to the metre reading room and take readings. Thus, keeping track of and monitoring your power use is a time-consuming chore. We can utilise the Internet of Things to automate this. By automating distant data collecting, the Internet of Things eliminates the expense. We must choose a current sensor and a voltage sensor so that the voltage and current can be monitored and we can learn about the electricity utilization and overall power utilized.

articleTitle: Power-Efficient Cluster Head Selection in Wireless Sensor Networks using Whale and Seagull Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: WSN includes deployed sensors. These small sensor nodes have energy limits since their batteries can't be replaced. Collect, transmit, and transfer data to the base station. Data transmission depletes WSN energy. Clustering is an efficient WSN data transport technique. Whale Optimization (WSOA) combines a seagull method with a global issue to meet global optimization concerns. The suggested technique helps choose based on residual node energy and nearby nodes, energy-aware cluster heads energy into consideration. Lifetime, energy economy, throughput, and stability of the recommended algorithm are tested. The hybrid metaheuristic's performance is compared to LEACH. The suggested approach outperforms others in residual energy, network longevity, and stability period.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Reading Aid for Stone blind Individuals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In this digital and modernized era, people acquire and enhance their knowledge by going through printed books and digital documents. But it is restricted only to people with clear vision. On the other side, it is still cumbersome for stone blind and visually impaired people to read and understand the books and documents they wish to read. Though Braille system is one of the procedure present, but many a times, published documents do not have braille or audio versions for the sake of those blind people. Even though different electronic equipment was available nowadays, but they were expensive for every blind people to afford. To overcome these limitations for those people, we have proposed an intelligent device that helps and assists the stone-blind people to read the printed text in the document. This paper focuses on the implementation of photo to speech application for those people. This is a smart integrated system which incorporates a camera through which we provide the document which is further processed by Optical Character Recognition (OCR) software using Raspberry Pi. In this project, we have added an additional new feature that consists a motor controlled by an IC that enables the equipment to turn to the next page when it reaches to the end of a particular page in a book. So, this project enables the stone-blind people to read the books and documents by hearing through audio generated by the proposed equipment.

articleTitle: Modified Bridgeless Landsman Converter Fed EV Battery Charger Power Factor Improvement
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This study offers a fresh Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) charger design and execution, together with strong front-end component development. In the suggested setup, a modified Landsman Force Component Correction (PFC) converter would replace the conventional diode converter in the existing EV battery charger supply line. The flyback remote converter is cascaded from the PFC converter. This enables the EV battery to be charged in two different modes: constant voltage mode and stable modern mode. The suggested PFC converter is managed using an unmarried detection unit to maintain a stable law of DC link voltage and ensure the operation of anti-aggregation components. The proposed topology gives advanced strength quality, less tool stress, low enter and output modern ripple with low enter modern harmonics while in comparison to the traditional one. In addition, to illustrate that the proposed charger complies with the IEC 6100032 standard, we can prototype and check a 48VEV battery with a ability of 100Ah beneath Neath enter voltage transients. The overall performance of the charger is first-class in all cases.

articleTitle: IoT based Control and Management for Parking System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Using Internet of Things technology, a practical and clever method of automating parking system management that allots a useful parking place. The Internet of Things offers wireless connectivity to the system, allowing the user to monitor the parking lot's availability. Road congestion is the main issue that is being encountered due to an increase in the number of cars in urban areas. This paper's goal is to find a solution to this problem. The user often wastes his or her time and energy trying to find a vacant place in a designated parking lot. The user receives the parking information through an LCD panel at the parking entry. Traffic congestion and air pollution are results of the parking issue. Today's situation makes it difficult for people to find parking spaces in their daily lives. A new estimate predicts that by 2035, there will be over 1.6 billion vehicles on the road worldwide. We burn almost one million barrels of oil per day in our daily lives. Consequently, a smart parking system is a crucial component of the fuel waste reduction strategy. The answer to the issues that are The cost of gasoline burned while looking for a parking spot may be reduced overall as well as the user's time and efficiency with the help of smart parking.

articleTitle: An Astute Rescue System for Enhanced Security using Facial Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Nowadays in this digital world, the design of intelligent home system is gaining more attention in people. Some of the key areas to be looked into are authentication of devices connected through internet, secure identification, data privacy, continuous internet connectivity and the security of data stored. The existing systems lack either of these issues, but our proposed system not only satisfies them but has intelligent and smart decision-making capability. Our paper primarily concentrates on children safety and ensures security in every aspect. The proposed system employs Raspberry Pi for processing the data which is measured by the sensor and communicate to the user through the internet. As Raspberry Pi 4 is the latest version and has much more functions, it is used and provided with Type <tex>$\mathbf{C}$</tex> supply. The designed system helps to save the small children from the harmful or tragic situation in the absence of parents. The solenoid lock works according to the command given by the user through the mobile application. Hence as the user commands according to the information that he observe on his mobile application. So, by implementing this project commercially, it saves the life of small children.

articleTitle: Application of IoT with PIR and Air Quality Gas Sensors for Classrooms and Buildings
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: These days, three modules are expected to be used to control the lights and fans in the classroom. The common sensors are used in situations where the energy safety and efficiency of the electricity is necessary. In all of these circumstances, the sensors can be burglary alarms or surveillance cameras that automatically turn on when they detect nearby motion. This can be used for saving energy consumption by turning off lights and fans in a building as it no longer can detect any activity and is frequently used. The PIR sensors are lightweight, low-powered, low cost, and simple to use. In most cases, they arrive with a white mask. By detecting temperature differences between locations, they may detect movements. In addition to the PIR, the circuit also contains an oxygen analyzer, an air quality gas sensor, and a GSM module so that we may receive a message on our phones letting us know how often energy is being utilized and conserved as well as how well the ventilation is working in that location. We can figure out the amount of oxygen circulating in the environment using an oxygen analyzer. Furthermore, we can identify the presence of various harmful gasses in the environment by employing an air quality analyzer. We can maintain a clean and clear atmosphere with the guidance of the oxygen analyzer and the air quality sensor incorporated into the system. The PIR sensor circuit will detect human activity, and rely on how it responds, it will transmit the data acquired to the Arduino controller, which will control the switching.action and the following sensors like air quality sensor, oxygen analyzer, and GSM module helps to manage the proposed method so that it aids in the consumption and savings of electricity in the classrooms and building. With the help of this suggested method, we are able to advance our extraordinary environmental healing with air.

articleTitle: A Mobile Charger Through A Solar Panel Fabricated from Silicon Scrap
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This research article focuses on a mobile charger fabricated through a solar panel from silicon scrap cells. There are more than twenty processes involved in making a solar panel. glass loading, front EVA Cutter, templates, stringer, layup, busing, ribbon, L Ribbon, U Ribbon, barcode, back EVA and back sheet, EL Visual, Laminator, Auto Trimming, Lamination, Junction Box, Curing Line, Frame Corner Buffing, Sun Stimulator, Hipot Testing, EL and Visual, Packing and Loading. The cells are connected by series through ribbon and framed with laminator. The 12 V cable is fitted instead of the junction box through which the data cable connected and the charging process is done. In this project, the mobile phone will charge 1% in two-minute duration of time. It will also be charged for a similar time period due to heat absorbed in the solar panel. The output can be used for multiple mobile phones to be charged at a time. Charging of various low voltage devices can be charged according to the panel size and then battery analyzer. Solar energy can be harnessed only during the daytime. To overcome this, solar panels are joined through a backup battery, for storing the surplus power in the day and used to supply power in the night. The lead acid battery is non-portable due to its size and weight. So, a battery of smaller size and lesser weight is designed.

articleTitle: Implementation of Security-Based Energy-Efficient Dynamic Street Lighting System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Street lights use 16 percent of the nation's total energy production. The majority of energy is spent on inefficient lighting. This is an energy and capital depletion. A large amount of the world's energy is used for street lighting. Street lights are used for both public and domestic lighting, and their size and usage vary depending on the lighting function. When we consider that an LED street light unit consumes roughly 80 Watts of power, such that energy may conserve and enhance street light efficiency. The main aim of this system is to reduce power consumption. The significance of our proposed system is automatically street lights will turn off during the daytime and automatically turn on at night time the intensity of light automatically decreases when no vehicle moments on the streets and automatically increases when there is a vehicle movement on street. It can be used where the lights are remained ON with 10 percent intensity and when the vehicle passes by the lights ahead of it are switched on with 100 percent intensity and the trailing lights revert to 10 percent intensity. Additionally, the system will send a notification to authorities whenever the street light is damaged or any fault in the street light. The smart street light system consists of an emergency service button it supports to notify services such as ambulance, fire, and police during emergency cases. This System can operate in two modes i.e from solar energy and whenever insufficient solar energy is taken from an external power supply. By detecting and approaching vehicles using infrared sensors and turning on a block of bright street lights in front of it, this system offers a way to save electricity. The moment the vehicle crosses the light, the lamps automatically dim.

articleTitle: Energy Saving Through Optimal DG Dispatch with DSM for Residential Consumers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The emerging communication technologies enable an effective management of Distributed Energy Resources (DER) used in electric power distribution systems so as to form a smart distribution network. The use of Demand Side Management (DSM) strategies in conjunction with effective planning of renewable energy sources decreases energy waste. In this research, the DSM applicable to residential consumers modifies the load curve by shifting the loads from peak to off-peak times. A simple genetic algorithm (SGA) is used for the optimal dispatch of Distributed Generation (DG) sources after load rescheduling. Thus DG optimization with responsive load scheduling reduces the energy consumption from the conventional grid and thereby encourages net zero carbon emissions. An IEEE 33 bus test system is considered for the study and the optimized results are presented.

articleTitle: A Keyframe Extraction for Edited Video Summarization using Spatio -Temporal Analysis of GLCM based Texture Measures
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Due to advancement of camera devices, huge amounts of digital video data are generated. To browse and analyze this video content, the user takes more time. In order to reduce the time to analyze and browse the video content, a summary is to be created. It can be achieved by extracting keyframes of the original video. This paper presents a summarization technique for edited video by using the GLCM representation. The unique content is determined for evaluating inter-frame difference by the following texture features such as Energy, Homogeneity, Mean, and Contrast. The pre-defined threshold values are set for each feature to select the appropriate keyframes. The summarization model is designed to capture the important properties of each frame. Specifically, this model is applicable to edited videos. This model was evaluated by two benchmark datasetsviz.,TVsum50 and SumMe. Finally, experimental results were compared with the benchmark existing algorithms to evaluate the efficiency of the proposed work.

articleTitle: Smart Traffic Density and Emergency Signal Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Traffic congestion causes many problems, and deaths occur as a result of delays in emergency vehicles reaching their destinations. Therefore, our top priorities are to reduce traffic in society and create space for emergency vehicles to move through traffic freely. The project comprises of two phases. In phase one, Arduino nano is deployed to program a command for 4-way directional control, and in phase two, the Arduino UNO is used to program for emergency situation control. The traffic lights are altered to only turn ON at that precise moment, up until or unless the frequency of emergency vehicles coincides with the sensor's operating range. The sensor in this instance is positioned at a specific distance to optimize the density and frequency of traffic flow in order to maintain an effective traffic signal control system at a specific intersection. The traffic lights continue to handle their standard delay function once none of the sensors have detected a sign.

articleTitle: Energy Based Streaming Consumption in Virtual Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In Today's world there is an availability of “always-on” communication which shows how people have tremendous interest in interacting socially. In particular sociologist has a question whether there is any access of face-to-face interaction through Bluetooth which may increases or decreases the access in smart phones. Previously a process triangulation was used which used to search for a definite position i.e. if the person are in proper distance or not? Furthermore complications arise by the fact that whether we can increase the distance from (1-1.5m) to wide variety of distance. GPS and Wi-Fi were the existing approaches which failed to encounter the requirement of elasticity and accurateness. In this paper the proposed system is an estimation model to determine the distance between the different environments using RSSI value of Bluetooth. Just like” We Chat” app in smart phones we can search friends in and around 10m and have a face-to-face interaction without the help of Internet. Even using the proximity estimation you can lock your computer when we go out. It locks on one of your Bluetooth devices which are paired to the machine. When you walk away from the computer the device automatically gets disconnected and the computer is locked after a timeout.

articleTitle: Hybrid Energy Storage based PQ Conditioner for DG Integrated Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: More and more renewable energy sources are being integrated into the electricity grid as a result of the quick advancement in distributed generation technology and the in-fluence of government support policies. Integration with existing electrical loads and power networks is a major barrier to the market adoption of these technologies. Switching devices during the integration are increasingly being used, which inevitably leads to a decline in power quality. At the same time, these devices are also more likely to break down as a result of bad power quality. Hence, an enhanced energy storage system with the duo of super magnetic and battery compensator is proposed to assure consistent power delivery and safeguard critical loads from interrupted power delivery. The proposed compensator is used for grid-connected PV wind farm units and tested for different scenarios of power quality fluctuations that are modelled in MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Investigation of Vanadium Penta-Oxide Based Insulate Gate BipolarTransistors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Insulated gate bipolar gate transistors, or IGBTs, are semiconductor-based devices principally utilized in inverter and converter applications. As ideas of energy-saving devices, existing IGBT materials have poor electrical conductivity unit efficiency. A significant weakness in the existing power electronic drive system is the inability to generate non-volatile electric field control. Compounds containing vanadium dioxide (VO2) is used as a voltage control device to improve electrical conductivity and reduce energy consumption. The electrical conductivity characteristics of IGBTs based on vanadium pentoxide are enhanced in the suggested study (V2O5). The simulated MATLAB environment of the IGBT based on V2O5 maintains. IGBT based on V2O5 simulated MATLAB environment maintains greater conductivity compared to conventional semiconductor-based materials, a decrease gate voltage for switch on and off further to improve conductivity.

articleTitle: Semantic Analysis of Food Ordering and Tasting Reviews in Web Pages using Deep Convolution Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Nowadays, users on the net face many issues love junk knowledge on unwanted web content, security issues, intense search time, unwanted advertisements, and so on to beat the matter of looking online pages, a replacement plan has been projected to get web pages victimization the calculated connexion worth, the connection of user representations and inputs. It is accessed by selecting the web contents weight classification and find the gap value of web pages by Markoff properties such as interpretation (G), cross validation web page (C), optimality (0). Finally, the satisfaction value for the user was calculated to rank the web pages according to the worth of the relationship.

articleTitle: Laminated busbar optimization concerning physical aspects, materials, and structural modifications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Laminated bus bars have better stray parameters such as lower stray inductance, in comparison with conventional cabling systems or wiring harnesses. Laminated busbars also provide better packaging of components in a system, making them more efficient in electric vehicle applications since they include size and mass constraints too. The work focuses on the optimization of a laminated bus bar structure with regard to physical aspects, materials, and structural modifications for better stray parameters. A laminated bus bar used in electric vehicles with a width of 305 mm, length of 203 mm, conductor thickness of 2 mm, and insulator thickness of 0.5 mm is considered. Optimization of the laminated busbar structure is commenced by varying the shape and position of the terminals over several topologies for better stray inductance. Material variations in the laminated bus bar and its impact on the stray capacitance are also studied. Furthermore, structural modifications such as cavities, radiused corners, edges, and overlapping terminals are implemented on the laminated busbar structure for improved overall stray parameters. The development of 3D models and analyses are performed using FEM software, Ansys Q3D extractor.

articleTitle: Design of a Hybrid Model for Controlling Flow Rate Using Venturimeter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Ordinary tap water and drilling water contain a large number of TDS of about 500ppm, making it salty water that is difficult to ingest. Continued intake further consumption can lead to typhoid fever, cholera and diarrhea. Another related issue is that passing 5 liters of water leaves almost 3 liters of water out of the RO. The TDS of product water is higher than the normal drilling, and biofilms form due to continuous water consumption and improper cleaning of vessels. Consuming this water leads to serious health problems over time. A low-cost, non-power, gravity-driven membrane chlorination technology for water purification systems. Recontamination during transport storage is a common problem in water supplies. Chlorination is intended to reduce recontamination. Polycans are used for storage and transportation towards drinking water. This paper provides a proposed solution for developing a gravity-driven membrane system for chlorine storage (liquid, pellets) plans to developing a prototype model for disinfection of drinking water.

articleTitle: Blink To Speak an assistive device for Paralyzed people
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Today, 1 in 5 persons over the age of 20 will experience a stroke at some point in their lifetime. If a stroke affects one side of the brain, such as the left, the opposing side of the body, such as the right, will become paralyzed. Hemiplegia is the name for this particular form of unilateral paralysis. These people who are paralyzed can see and hear what is going on around them, but they are unable to converse with them since one side of their body will be totally paralyzed. Their capacity to talk will be diminished if the paralysis affects their facial muscles. These patients must be able to communicate their wants and thoughts because they are unable to talk and perform any bodily tasks on the side of their bodies that is injured. Since “Eye-Blink” is an automatic reflex (though it can sometimes be voluntary), the affected individual can effectively blink the eye on the unaffected side. Therefore, in this research, we developed a system that recognizes a wink and speaks out to convey the person's thoughts and desires. This system's advantages include low cost and ease of transportation due to its compact size. It is also taken into account that it causes some discomfort to the patient because they have to blink their eyes constantly when it is necessary to communicate. Flickering is detected by an infrared sensor and each blink counts a word or phrase describing regular activities like eating, sleeping, drinking, etc. will be given as voice over speaker and can also perform an activity (automation).

articleTitle: CentredSourced high gain Multilevel Boost Converter for Renewable application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: It is suggested to use a centred-sourced multilevel boost converter topology. The output voltage of fuel cells and other sustainable green energy sources, like solar cells, is quite low. To effectively use renewable sources, a multilevel boost converter with a focused source was suggested. The primary benefits of this configuration are the reduction of input current stress with high gain, a big conversion ratio, and an acceptable duty cycle that permits high switching frequency. The suggested converter has been modelled and prototyped.

articleTitle: Silhouette-Based Haman Action Recognition Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Nowadays BAR is gaining interest in computer vision area. The BAR system was utilized and applied in various applications related to surveillance. Some of the surveillance applications are airport surveillance, shop surveillance, bank, schools, and many areas. The goal is to recognize human actions automatically. If the raw video is taken as input without any preprocessing then the human action recognition system consumes more time and leads to increased storage space. So in this work silhouette is prefered to extract the features with a time and space consuming manner. and finally CNN is used to classify the actions. The standard Weizmann dataset and KTH dataset is used to evaluate and manipulate the performance of the proposed HAR technique. The proposed method provides 98 percent accuracy for the Weizmann dataset and 93 percent accuracy for the KTH dataset. The HAR technique provides efficient outcome than the recent existing techniques that are used for used for human action recognition(HAR) systems.

Author Keywords: Motion feature extraction using optical flow

articleTitle: A portable spirometer using machine learning approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Wheezing is a prime non-communicable disease among all age groups. It affects the air flow towards lungs by inflaming and narrowing the passage. Asthma relevant mortality occur in low and lower-middle revenue countries. In global arena, according to a report by world health organization about 417,918 deaths occur due to asthma. These sort of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease affects more than 10 million people every year. Spirometry is the universally used test for pulmonary functions. The obstructive and restrictive disease diagnosis and prognosis could be evaluated with this test. In this work, a lab model of a portable spirometer is aimed to be developed. This spirometer utilizes a flow sensor to acquire the respiratory signal and transmits the signal to Raspberry Pi for further processing. The identification or prediction of certain lung disease could be identified with the help of demographic parameters and particular symptoms of the subjects. Prime attributes are extricated from the acquired signals. Automatic decision support is executed via algorithms such as support vector machine, Naive Bayes, voting classifier are implemented to demarcate wheeze from normal subjects. Results demonstrate that the methodology adopted here is a promising method for lung disease identification and classification.

articleTitle: Smart System for E-Vehicle Management
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Nowadays, Electric Vehicle (EV) is becoming popular since the fuel prices becoming more expensive. The use of electrical energy sources may improve the environment since there is less pollution. Cars produce a lot of carbon emissions that are ejected into our natural atmosphere, leaving us vulnerable to things like pollution and greenhouse gases. In order to positively help the environment we live in, an electric car is a great step forward. Even though, electric vehicle is the need of the hour, it too has numerous problems associated with it like, safety of existing battery technology. A battery pack of lithium-ion cells is akin to a small explosive. Keeping a close eye on parameters like voltage, charge, and temperature becomes highly important. An unchecked thermal runaway can cause explosion or fire which can be fatal for the vehicle occupants. The system aims at providing a better view of the vehicle's voltage, current, estimated running time left, estimated running distance and so on to the user through a mobile app so that the user gets the insights of the vehicle. There is also a huge need for monitoring the movement of vehicle in case if the EV is being used as a public usable vehicle (ex college campus, office campus, etc.). The movement of the vehicle can be tracked using software like GPS. This helps the organization to track and organize vehicle movement. Proper authorization problems if it is to be used only by particular set of people in an organization. To solve this problem the RFID software is used in order to give authorization to a vehicle. The admin can decide who can access and who cannot.

articleTitle: A Framework of Medical Image Segmentation using Edge Stop Function based on Contour Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Liver cancer is a major taker of lives in recent years. Generally, a liver cancer death rate is very high because the disease shows no symptoms and it's often not caught until the final stages. Traditional Segmentation methods include Region-Based which is based on Intensity and Gradient information which can be applied only when the images has constant gradient information. The Edge-Based Segmentation technique, though can be applied to images with diverse homogeneities, can't be applied to images with non-definitive boundaries. We propose a novel method for liver cancer detection using robust edge stop functions based on Contour detection and Artificial Neural Networks with the Wavelet Features separated from the source input image. By incorporating the gradient information along with the probability scores from a typical classifier, an algorithm is constructed which is applied for the ESF Model. Also the wavelet features classify a dataset and then get the result in normal and abnormal stages. The K-nearest neighbors and SVM approve the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Voltage Regulation for Soft Switching Multiphase IBC Using Fuzzy Logic Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Power factor is a crucial element in determining the performance of for ac mains supply fed two stage ac/dc/dc converters. Thereby many topology variants have been developed to minimize/mitigate conduction loss, switch stress and overall working efficiency. This proposal a soft-inter leaved boost converter (SS-IBC) by incorporating reserve resonant circuit primarily for EVs. Various phases of the afore-mentioned converter are coupled/connected/linked to thereby construct / form a multi leaved boost convertor. The operation of the proposed model is analogous to single phase boost convertor. Each of the several stage are preferably similar with shifted control signals enabled by PWM which implements uniform switching frequency and duty cycles. The aforementioned invertor proves to be an economically feasible/economic/ cost efficient upgrade/retrofit to battery charging requirements with reference to grid connected applications. It was observed that steady ad reliable supply offered to conventional energy storage systems can also be achieved with renewable options like photovoltaic (PV), fuel cell systems, etc.,. The key merits of the proposed design/system boasts lower ripple current, lower voltage stress and measurably higher efficiency in comparison to traditional design/circuitry.

articleTitle: Modified U Net Based Learning Model for Semi Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The applications include scene interpretation, medical image processing, robotic perception, video based scrutiny systems, augmented and virtual reality, among many others the image segmentation is a being a key topic. In the literature, many picture segmentation methods have been created, and there have been a lot of recent efforts aimed at creating image segmentation algorithms using deep learning models due to the success of these models in a broader range of vision based utilities. The adaptability of a learning model to segment medical images like Modified U-net based convolution neural network has shown good results in retinal vessel region extraction and has greater feature learning capability.Therefore, using the DRIVE and STARE datasets, we compare the accuracy, specificity, and sensitivity of modified U-Net deep learning with those of the U-Net model, and we also highlight several promising future research directions.

articleTitle: SmartWear - An Integrated Watch for Patients
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The edge cutting technologies like IoT-Internet of Things and Cloud computing transforms the world with the production of smart devices. Health care and control of home appliances proves to be an area of concern when it comes to personalization and safety of the user such that it can be operated and carried easily by them. The development in technology has paved the way to smart devices, in which smart wearable field is growing at rapid pace. The proposed idea is to integrate a wearable device with home automation and health care, which make user's life smarter and easier. SmartWear has three main features, home automation, health monitoring and integration of these two features. It makes the patient comfortable by keep track of the healthy life and automating their surroundings. This SmartWear monitors thepatient's heart rate and in case of any uncommon health state, instantly data is sent to the trusted contact of that patient along with the GPS location. Also surrounding atmosphere can be adjusted according to the patient's body conditions. It aids in controlling the home appliances and monitoring the health of the patient in a singlesystem. IoT, Cloud and Voice recognition can be used for health monitoring and homeautomation. Integration of these two in done using cloud protocol. It allows the patients to automate for their own comfort care without others dependency.

articleTitle: Bit Wise Multipliers Using Symmetric Stackers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: All computing units, including the Digital Signal Processing (DSP) applications, Multiply Accumulate Unit (MAU), and Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), require high speed multipliers. The efficiency of data multiplication is a common performance limiter for DSP systems. Therefore, there is a great need right now for multiplier algorithms that are fast and consume less energy. The design of fast and speed efficient multipliers based on symmetric stacking-based binary counters. This study analyses a Wallace tree multiplier using symmetric stacking-based counters as well as traditional counters. In terms of latency and area, the performance is also contrasted. Verilog HDL and Xilinx are used in programming and synthesis.

articleTitle: Power Scavenging Using a Darrieus Type Vertical Axis Wind Turbine on Highways
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In day-to-day life, Energy is an important aspect. For producing electricity, Non-Renewable sources are used. As these sources are limited, there is a need to move from non-renewable to renewable sources. Among all renewable energy sources, Wind is the best source because it has lower effects on the environment than other energy sources. For a constant supply of wind, Highways appear to be the best. So, the idea is to design a darrieus-type vertical axis wind turbine that will be placed along the medians of the highways. In this way, the wind from both sides of the highways will be observed by the blades. Since fluctuation occurs in wind sources due to environmental conditions, a storage system is needed for a constant supply. So, the generated power will be stored in the batteries for future use.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithm For KY Converter based Battery Integrated Grid Tied PV System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Today's power generation relies heavily on renewable energy, which also contributes to distributed generation, Microgrid and smart cities. PV system is a rapidly developing source of renewable energy and acts as stand-alone or grid-connected systems. The utilization of PV energy faces a drastic increase due to the high efficiency of solar cells and enhancements in the design of PV panels. It demands high gain converters for major applications but existing converters generate pulsating outputs leading to output voltage with ripples. In this view, researchers are constantly focusing on converters with increased efficiency and gain generating minimized ripples in resulting current and voltage. Considering these dilemmas, an efficient PV system with KY converter is introduced in this article. The KY converter provides improved voltage conversion ratio as well as maintain DC voltage. The proposed converter is regulated by an ANN controller for solving the optimization issues. It prevents the local optimum and is robust, simple with the application to complicated optimization tasks. A grid connected single-phase VSI is adopted for ensuring smooth operation with the aid of PWM generator. The simulations are carried out in MAT LAB simulation software to prove the efficacy of the introduced approach. The obtained outputs reveal that this developed system has minimal THD and hence it has higher efficiency.

articleTitle: Modeling of Grid Connected Hybrid System for Non Linear Load
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper proposes the concept of a hybrid system linked to the grid for a non-linear load. The hybrid system consists of a photovoltaic (PV) system which is modeled with maximum power point tracking (MPPT) controller and a wind system which is designed with PMSG. This system is incorporated with grid side converter (GSC) and machine side converter (MSC) (i.e., back-to-back converters). To balance the voltage with the non-linear load at the grid side, the parameters are adjusted by a PI controller with DQ transformation technique. Thus, voltage unbalance is mitigated and the obtained simulation results are analyzed in MatLab/Simulink for a power of 2.4 kW hybrid system.

articleTitle: Sanitization Using Autonomous Drone
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Since the COVID -19 epidemic has nearly brought about global catastrophe, every chance to make things better must be considered. One such technique for improvement is airborne decontamination. Researching this method's efficacy in the pandemic is vital since it can be used for surface cleaning of bigger areas. There are numerous instances of using drones to disinfect areas affected by epidemics, but best practices and factors affecting effectiveness have not yet been found. The adaptable uses of agricultural drones are evident from reports about utilizing drones for disinfection during a pandemic. The authors of this study calculated the potential amount of disinfectant fluid per unit area using various parameters for fly speed, flight altitude, and flow rate. As a result, by adjusting the settings, a range of disinfectant concentrations per unit area can be provided. Even though the results create a lot of new queries, they can be used to determine appropriate flying characteristics based on various disinfection liquids.

articleTitle: Density Based Traffic Congestion Control System and Emergency Vehicle Clearance
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: With the growing population, traffic congestion in cities is one of the most urgent concerns. Congestion not only causes additional delay and stress for the driver but also increases fuel consumption and pollution. The existing traffic management system does not offer priority when emergency vehicles are seen because it is a timer-based traffic control system. Ambulances, fire trucks, and other emergency vehicles are unable to arrive on time because of the traffic jams on the roadways. So, in order to reduce traffic congestion in daily life, our proposed methodology measures the density of vehicles at a 4-way junction. In the absence of emergency vehicles, the proposed system gives green light automatically based on the density of vehicles on the road. The traffic light changes according to the signal emitted by the sensor. Using an RF transmitter and receiver, the signal priority is switched to the lane in which an emergency vehicle is present. This system incorporates the entire traffic system and operates in emergency scenarios to ensure quick arrival at the desired location without any delay.

articleTitle: An Investigation Report on Spoting and Diagnosing Diseases from the Images of Brain by Convolutional Neural Network Method Using Fusion Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: One of the destructive diseases which leads to a very short life in higher grade is brain tumor. The brain tumor imaging technologies play an essential role in concentrating and evaluating the novel perception of operations and brain anatomy. For classification purpose a convolutional neural network using fusion support vector machine is used. The outcome is combined to categorize the input image in to two classes like normal and abnormal with improved accuracy, sensitivity and specificity.

articleTitle: Smart Solid and Wet Waste Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Modern cities produce an excessive amount of rubbish, and the laborious manual labour needed to process it makes the task seem pointless. This affects the climatic conditions which is the major cause for global warming. In this paper the smart waste segregator is created to make it simple to dispose the collected waste. It aims to segregate waste as biodegradable and non-biodegradable wastes. The waste is introduced into the conveyor belt to be separated. The metallic trash is located using an electromagnet. The wet waste is detected using the moisture sensor. The ultrasonic detectors are used for sensing the user near the bin to open the lid. They are also present in the conveyor and used for level detection purpose. This system also involves gas sensor for odour detection purpose. The servo motor is used for rotating the bin to certain angle for segregating the biodegradable and non-biodegradable wastes. The system is driven by microcontroller Arduino UNO.

articleTitle: Automated Attendance System based on Facial Recognition using Adaboost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: As the pandemic hits the world, our whole education system adapted to the new online system which has many perks and a few minor drawbacks. So to minimize all the flaws of the online education system we have made software that uses the Facial Recognition system for the attendance of the students. The approach is to use the AI Facial Recognition System, it uses the multiple layers and photos capturing technique to capture an accurate picture of a human face with help of Ai ML algorithms like AdaBoost, and Geometry-based algorithms. The given system is built on the TKINTER platform and has a PYTHON script and a SQL database to back it up. The system's algorithm compares images based on the values of the face in the database image and the real-time image taken in the system. To store the data of the users we have used pandas which feeds the input and output in Excel. Apart from this, we have some ML libraries which are pre-trained like haar cascade - for facial recognition and OpenCV. We needed to keep the software easy to use and small in size in which we succeeded by creating an admin authorization to add new students. We have put forward both our ideas and our abilities to create an “Automated Attendance System Based on Face Recognition.”

articleTitle: Onsite maintenance identification of loose connections in battery set and testing connected with fire Diesel Pump generator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Switch gear robustness has a significant impact on power distribution system efficiency. The engineering factors that influence fire safety performance in commercial and government buildings have been investigated. During project work, all factors such as building structure, fire prevention compartments from damage, impression on people's evacuation routes, control design for being on fire, and further stable fire protection facilities are considered for fire safety design. The fire safety of commercial and government buildings is frequently impacted by renovation engineering. This article summarizes the Diesel fire pump, Battery, and Water pumping system classifications, as well as the factors influencing fire performance.

articleTitle: Vehicular Network Protocol with IOT in Traffic Scenarios with Safety Requirements-A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Ad hoc networks for vehicles are increasingly becoming a fruitful subject for transportation research. VANET makes it possible for many vehicles to communicate because it has its own set up and framework for efficient data delivery services. Data cannot be transmitted between automobiles with a modification in their configurations due to their rapid mobility. In contrast hand, the faultless characteristics of vanet routing algorithms provide adequate connectivity for reliable and efficient data transmission in busy environments. This survey article opens with a discussion of traffic congestion and efforts to make a smart urban smarter by broadcasting information to adjacent cars. Then, when traffic is heavy, we concentrate on several strategies using different routing protocols at junctions and traffic signals. Additionally, it illustrates the idea and routing system used in the region.

articleTitle: Improvised FOC and Speed Estimation of PMSM using Reinforcement Learning and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In this study, field-oriented control of a sensor less Interior PMSM with the help of Artificial Neural Network (ANN) is carried out by utilizing both Proportional-Integral (PI) controllers and Reinforcement learning (RL). Making a high-speed response controller, which improves the motor by its performance, requires the appropriate control strategy for the motor and the results from each method are compared. A Deep Neural Network is built and trained to estimate both rotor's position and speed. Thus, removing the need for sensors, which increases drive system complexity, and costs. A Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradients (TD3) method is used for Reinforcement Learning. It is a combination of both actor and critic networks that finds the best policy to implement in order to maximize the estimated cumulative long-term reward. Due to the above-mentioned benefits, PMSMs are frequently utilized in modern variable speed AC drives, especially in applications involving electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Smart Class-II Device with Integrated Medi-Tools
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the 21st century, technology has achieved unexpected growth in the world and this is not yet completed we are going to experience more innovative technology in upcoming years. While handling with thoughts its all about the trending technology called Brain-Computer Interface (BCI), by mastering these technologies we can innovate enormous things. All this feature is designed and served for a paralyzed person, which feels the person take care themselves without any support. This model will be a budget-friendly model.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Various Cloud Service Providers: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Cloud computing refers to a location in which information can be accessed remotely. By storing files and apps on remote servers, cloud service providers allow their customers to access them via the Internet. This implies that the user does not need to be at a specific location to obtain access to it, allowing them to work remotely. In addition, Cloud computing offers several advantages and problems to small, medium, and big businesses. Any corporation, whether in the financial, technological, or engineering sectors, may discover a valuable cloud component for the organization's demands. There are various cloud service providers that exist in the present market and are highly sought after by enterprises to meet their demands, but Amazon Web Services, Oracle Compute, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform and IBM Cloud are the most extensively utilized. The aim of this review paper is to present a comparative study of the various cloud service providers with respect to the pricing model, compute services, storage services, key cloud tools, database services, networking services, management services, and security services. Furthermore, its key benefits and drawbacks are also present so that it becomes easier to select the most appropriate one for deployment and research development.

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Detection with Data Sampling
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Credit card fraud, although not directly impacting banks, does have repercussions for the financial sector as a whole. Criminals pose a significant threat to safety since they are continually thinking up new methods to commit these types of fraud. Early detection of fraudulent behavior is therefore vital to retain customer trust and defend the firm. Since lawful transactions far outnumber fraudulent transactions, which typically make up less than 1% of all transactions, addressing the class imbalance issue in the data presents a significant challenge for developing fraud detection algorithms. It is challenging to identify a positive example (fraudulent case), and this challenge increases as more data is gathered, leading to a lower proportion of positive examples. Because of this, research is very important. Models for making predictions were trained in this study utilizing a variety of sampling strategies, including the ANN, GBM, and the RF. Models used SMOTE, RUS, DBSMOTE, and SMOTE plus ENS were all examples of Synthetic Minority Over-Sampling Technique (SMOTEENN). This research suggests that SMOTE-based sampling techniques will provide positive results. The highest recall (0.81) was achieved by the SMOTE sampling method when a DRF classifier was used. It was determined that this classifier has an accuracy score of 0.87. The Stacked Ensembling algorithm was accomplished using altogether of collected data, and its average performance was 0.78, making it the clear winner. As a fraud detection model, the Stacked Ensemble has performed well in most sampling operations.

articleTitle: A study on Users and Non-Users Scenario of Electric Vehicles in Remote Area
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: As a growing population and number of vehicles, the fuel demand is increasing day by day. To meet the total demand of consumers we have to switch to some other mode of renewable energy. In this direction, one of the most popular and effective method is to use electric vehicle (EVs). It is observed that still 70%-80% of people are not using EVs specifically in remote area. With this scenario, we have conducted a survey and tried to find the reasons for non-utilization of EVs at mass level even after development in technologies of EVs. A survey has been conducted to find the users' and non-users' scenario about EVs and collected data through all the possible ways. The detailed analysis completed of all the collected data and suggested various recommendations based on the observed data from users as well as non-users. If these recommendations implemented then we can get a hike in utilization of Electric Vehicle and can get a sustainable environment for our future generations.

articleTitle: Twiddle Factor Normalization Based Radix-2k Factorization for Improved Spectral Efficiency in Subcarrier Mapping
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Numerous signal processing algorithms, including many used in biomedical research, employ the Fourier transform extensively. Due to the computationally intensive nature of the FFT tasks, optimization models are necessary to reduce the computations' complexity to a more manageable level. In this article, we suggest optimizations that can reduce the number of mathematical operations necessary to compute the FFT. These optimizations may occur at either the architecture or application level. The proposed architecture for the fast Fourier transform makes use of lookup tables to reduce the number of times multiplication is performed. In addition, pre-processing units use integer multipliers to reduce the number of multipliers needed to perform complex multiplication when computing the FFT.

articleTitle: Design and Investigation of Automatic Pest Detection and Pesticide Spraying Device
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Agriculture is India's lifeblood. In our country, irrigated cropland covers approximately 215.6 million acres. Pest detection in paddy fields is a significant challenge in agriculture, so effective measures to combat the infestation while minimising pesticide use should be developed. Image analysis techniques are widely used in agricultural science, providing maximum crop protection and ultimately leading to better crop management and production. Pest infestations are currently monitored by hand, but automated monitoring is being developed to reduce human effort and errors. It is possible to accomplish this by using a camera to capture input images and then analyzing them with machine learning. A motor driver is used to build an agricultural robot, and a Raspberry Pi3 is used as the processor or embedded system. For machine learning, we use Python code to train the robot with predefined images. Pest infestations are currently monitored by hand, but automated monitoring is being developed to reduce human effort and errors. It is possible to accomplish this by using a camera to capture input images and then analyzing them with machine learning. A motor driver is used to build an agricultural robot, and a Raspberry Pi3 is used as the processor or embedded system. For machine learning, we use Python code to train the robot with predefined images. Farmers can control it without having to work in the fields or be exposed to pesticides, which is a benefit. His health does not affect him.

articleTitle: Authentication in the Internet of Vehicles using Blockchain Technology: Review
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Internet of Vehicles (IoV) aims to make transportation autonomous, safe, fast, and efficient while reducing resource waste and harmful environmental impacts. To happen this, IoV interconnects pedestrians, cars, and components of urban infrastructure. It uses numerous sensors, software, in-built hardware, and diverse connections to enable reliable and continuous communication. Therefore, they are prone to attacks that may lead to life-endangering consequences, so it is vital to develop security mechanisms to detect such attacks against IoV. Blockchain technology is one of the emerging technologies that have been used recently in Cybersecurity due to its robustness and integrity-preserving properties. Blockchain technology's immutability, tamper-proof, and security by design make it a promising technology for IoV. This study is a comprehension of existing work of securing IoV using blockchain techniques.

articleTitle: A Vulture Model Flapping - Wing with UAV Technology Based - A Novel Drone for Emergency and Safety Purpose Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
