articleTitle: A survey on state of art approaches in handling imbalance, positive and unlabelled data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Machine learning algorithm extends its horizon in various application domains. Real time applications in various sectors which can be effectively handled with machine learning techniques lack from it due to the unavailability of the required data. In such cases the data may be imbalanced, with a single class labeled and other unlabelled. However, this will be the prevailing scenario in future and has to be addressed. This work concentrates on studying the various approaches that are in practice to handle these kinds of data. In specific, it concentrates on approaches used for handling imbalance data sets and the recent works in it, methods used for handling positive unlabelled data. Though there are few solutions in practice for handling imbalance data and positive unlabelled data. Approaches that work at the data level and algorithm level approach for handling the former and techniques such as biased learning and class prior models for handling the later are in practice. One class classifier is another approach that can be used for addressing the problem that arises with the class imbalance in the dataset and related issues. It has also been noted from the literature that one class classifier will be more suitable but it has not been widely used in addressing the problems such as class rarity. It can be inferred from this study that the one class classifier would play a significant role in various domains in future.

articleTitle: Digital Holographic Based Food Supply Post Flood Assessment System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: There are many possible applications for virtual reality, which is regarded as the apex of human-computer interactions. In order to improve the standardization and automation of disaster operation management, a novel emergency management strategy based on activity network technology is presented. First, the emergency plan is constructed utilizing technology called an activity network and emergency response activities. Straight lines connecting waypoints of interest can be used to depict a virtual journey, although this basic model does not adequately capture ordinary user activity. We put the model into a framework that may be used to reroute medical and food assistance in various real-world and virtual settings. It is helpful for evaluating redirected parameters in different circumstances. In our concept, a flood scenario is the emergency that is needed, and the virtual hologram aids the user in gathering data from each person who requires assistance utilizing a wireless sensor network. The electronic civilization has undergone significant transformation thanks to embedded technology, which has a sizable community. Microcontrollers can be used by embedded systems to collectdata, process it, and produce reliable results. Intelligent principal layout and precise analysis are provided by simulation software when designing a project.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Fifteen Level Inverter for Renewable Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The design and development of a fifteen-level inverter for renewable applications is moving forward in our endeavor to reduce the environmental effect of solar power plant electricity generation. The produced DC must be converted to AC in order to connect an AC load to the grid without degrading grid performance. A multilayer inverter (MLI) is an appropriate option as it generates output voltage with stepped waveforms that are more similar to sinusoidal waveforms and have less harmonics. However, the DC voltage sources of switching devices expands and thus increasing the circuit design complexity and control. This paper employs just eight switches and one DC source in MLI to deliver a level output voltage for renewable energy applications.

articleTitle: Speech Recognized Face Composition Tool Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A face synthesis is a graphic representation of one or more eyewitness memories of a face recorded by a synthesis artist. Creating highly accurate forensic sketches typically requires several years of training before a forensic sketcher is proficient at drawing sketches. To address this issue, we develop a software tool that uses audio and image processing techniques to create facial composites based on eyewitness dictation narration. Successful technology that automatically matches face sketches to mugshots could also improve the effectiveness of face sketches, allowing such suspects to be apprehended more quickly.

articleTitle: Raspberry PI Based Automated Authentication and Monitoring System for The Examination Centers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The conduct of centralized examinations for many job postings and academic institutions demands an easy navigation and strong monitoring system. Malpractice is often referred as pretense of the person taking up the examination causing the act of deceit. Hall ticket are used for authentication along with the identity cards. The prevailing system of conduct of examination has the verification of the image manually in the process of authenticating the candidate. Malpractice in the examinations corrupts the quality of the entire education system. This work attempts to automate the face identification for identifying if any sort of deceit is being done by the candidate in venue of examination. It also detects the motion of the candidate while attempting to unauthorized work in the examination hall. The proposed work has three folds of objectives. Firstly it provides the easy navigation details for the candidates appearing for the examinations at common centers using the face recognition with Haar cascade algorithm. Secondly it provides the required navigation details only to the authenticated candidates. Third it provides the tight monitoring during the conduct of examination by detecting the motion of the candidates.

articleTitle: Speech Processing and Recognition of Sign Language using Tensor flow Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Communication facilitates social interaction and perspective exchange. Therefore, the deaf and mute face significant obstacles when attempting to participate in society. People are only able to communicate through the use of sign language. It is possible to translate sign languages into a form that can be used for public communication. To this end, we will develop a real-time system that can interpret and translate Sign Language into written language. The majority of the operation relies on custom-made components such as gloves and robotic arms. To complete this task, we employ a convolutional neural network and a deep learning strategy. Beginning with the Python library Keras for training convolutional neural networks, a sign-based classifier model is developed. Then, we utilised the real-time skin segmentation system to locate the Region of Interest within the bounding box. The classified region is utilised to predict the symbol. The classifier was found to be more effective against complex backgrounds and camera angles, and to translate sign language into speech and text that the hearing-impaired can comprehend.

articleTitle: Design of Miniaturized UWB Antenna for Skin Cancer Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A novel ultra-wide band (UWB) antenna is proposed that has the properties of miniaturization which can transmit and receive microwave signals in a particular location for skin cancer detection. The proposed miniaturized antenna has the radiating patch with T -slot in the patch plane. The size of the miniaturized antenna is 18mmx16mm which is <2cm. The wide impedance bandwidth of the miniaturized T slot antenna is about 8.2 to 19GHz. The maximum gain and directivity of the miniaturized antenna is 7.5dB and 9dB. The wide bandwidth and high resonating frequency is very much useful for skin cancer detection using microwave detection. The measured and simulated return loss output of the proposed T -shaped miniaturized antenna generate UWB signal range which is applicable for skin cancer detection.

articleTitle: Low Cost Mobile Inverted Pendulum Using Kalman Filter with Fuzzy Based PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the “Mobile Inverted Pendulum (MIP),” the robot with two-wheels can move front and back in a horizontal path and take the role of the cart in the basic inverted pendulum system. The usage of expensive sensors, like the SCC2130-D08-05 Murata, is a flaw in the current system. Our work includes modeling the MIP's State Space equation and utilizing MATLAB to examine the system's observability and controllability. To estimate the angular position of the MIP, a combination gyro sensor, accelerometer sensor along with Kalman filter is developed thereby reducing the cost of the model. PID controllers with FUZZY tuning are used in the proposed system. The MIP is stabilized using the PID. The PID gain settings in this case are tuned using a fuzzy method.

articleTitle: Power Control of Solar Grid-Tie Inverter Using Bidirectional DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Today, we are moving more and more towards green and sustainable energy. This has resulted in ever increasing integration of DGS to service grids. In solar grid-tied inverters, there is a continuous effort by Researchers to provide non-stop power force from Distributed generation systems (DGS) to the service grid to avoid the faults found in grids and to provide assistance to the grid during voltage sag situation. Improved topologies and control approaches have received a lot of attention in order to meet the goal of enhancing the accuracy of solar tied grid inverters, specifically at grid breakdowns. The main objective of this research is to provide a method, a very simple one and at the same time a very reliable and best control solution - envisaging a system for satisfactory performance under distorted grid condition for 3- position 4- line grid- tie inverters for power injection. We do this by utilizing two stages for separate management of the input and yield: a dc - dc converter that extracts the greatest energy from the solar PV modules and an inverter that transfers this electricity to the grid while maintaining grid standards. A DC link balancing solution is also described, which uses a proportionate regulator. The suggested method of control is modelled in the MATLAB-Simulink platform using a 3-position NPC (i.e.,) Neutral Point Clamped grid-tie inverter. The simulation findings are used to validate its performance in terms of operating under undesirable grid setup and reduces THD(i.e.,) Total Harmonic Distortion with the help of simulation results.

articleTitle: Smart Assistive Stick for Visually Impaired Person with Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: To fulfill one's desires, goals, and life objectives, independence is the key building block. For those who are visually challenged, going out on their own might be difficult. Many millions of individuals throughout the world are visually impaired person (VIP) and always in need of assistance. Ultrasonic sensors, an infrared sensor, a single camera, and a Bluetooth or earphones are all included in the stick for VIP. This system can identify obstructions up to 200 cm in front of, to the left of, and to the right of users by using a network of ultrasonic and infrared sensors. In the proposed work, these ultrasonic sensors are joined to an Arduino in order to process data further. The camera is utilized to capture images for object recognition, and the user will hear spoken captions and presentation of the captured image. This audio will serve as a substitute eye for persons who VIP by explaining what the image is and what to do if it poses a threat.

articleTitle: Machine Learning and Intelligent Network System based Covid 19 Health Care System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: COVID-19 has lately infected a big number of people worldwide. Medical service frameworks are strained as a result of the infection. The emergency unit, which is part of the medical services area, has experienced several challenges as a result of the low data quality offered by existing ICU clinical equipment. The Internet of Things has enhanced the capability for essential information mobility in medical services in the twenty-first century. Nonetheless, many of today's ideal models use IoT innovation to assess patients' well-being. As a result, executives lack understanding regarding the most effective method to apply such innovation to ICU clinical equipment. The IoT Based Paradigm for Medical Equipment Management Systems, a breakthrough IoT-based paradigm for successfully administering clinical hardware in ICUs, is introduced in this study. During the COVID-19 episode, IoT technology is used to boost the data stream between clinical hardware, executive frameworks, and ICUs, enabling the maximum level of openness and reasonableness in clinical equipment redistribution. IoT MEMS conceptual and functional features were painstakingly drawn. Using IoT MEMS expands the capacity and limits of emergency clinics, effectively easing COVID-19. It will also have a substantial impact on the nature of the data and will improve the partners' trust and transparency.

articleTitle: A Survey on Precision agriculture using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In modern farming fidelity permits the precise application of information sources, such as toxicant, seed, manure, and effluent, at the precise moment of harvest in order to increase productivity and crop yields. Ranchers may readily determine the crops' range by tracking them using sensors that are collected from the fields, protecting the resources being used and reducing the impact of weeds on the environment. Most Indian ranchers use standard cultivating techniques to determine the crop yield that should be developed in order. In any event, the ranchers don't sacrifice crop productivity because it depends on the characteristics of the soil due to abiotic variables. This research suggestsa yield recommendation apparatus that encourages ranchers to select the appropriate crop to plant in their lands in this manner. selecting information about systems by machine.

articleTitle: Reliability Prediction of Interleaved Boost Converter using Bayesian Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The power electronic converters are an integral part of the energy systems. There are wide range of applications of the converters from energy conversions to motor drives. With the increasing renewable energy sources, the need for intermediate DC – DC converters have also increased tremendously. Interleaved Boost Converter (IBC) is a more commonly used DC – DC converter, as it can work on stages thereby reducing the stress across the components. Along with the performance of a converter, its reliability also greatly decides the choice of the converters for an application. The reliability study of the converters plays a vital role in designing the safety systems for the converter. The paper presents the reliability prediction of IBC using Bayesian Belief Network (BBN) in detail.

articleTitle: Smart Highway Technique using Wind Turbine with Vertical Axis (VAWT)
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: An idea intends to use vehicle motion to generate electricity on the highways. In order to generate power, a Wind Turbine with Vertical Axis (VAWT) is used. A Wind Turbine with Vertical Axis is positioned in middle of the median of the highway. Vertical Turbines frequently move in the direction of the wind flow as a result of the rapid movement of vehicles. The project's primary focus is on producing power and using it for street lighting and the Toll Plaza's roadways. In this project, a Savonius wind turbine is used. This vertical wind turbine is linked to a generator that produces power by a gear system. This is a technique that will be used in the future to produce electricity on the side of the road, along the highway. Future uses of this project include either energizing the batteries of the electric vehicles or energizing the batteries of electric vehicles that are already on board. Although the Wind Turbine with Vertical Axis (VAWT) has low efficiency than the wind turbine with Horizontal Axis (HAWT), it has potential to play a significant role in production of power in the future.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Trapezoidal Antenna for UWB Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the majority of situations involving large groups of people at this time, it is not necessary to use a communication system with a high bandwidth. Using a trapezoidal antenna in a communication system with a broad bandwidth is something to consider if you want the best results possible from the system. Due to the phenomenon known as linear polarisation, a single antenna is capable of transmitting and receiving signals across a broad frequency spectrum. As a result, it is a very useful tool for monitoring the overall condition of the planet. By repeatedly running simulations, the voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) can be optimised for maximum performance across its usable frequency range. This will allow the widest frequency range possible to be utilised. In order to rectify the situation, it is sufficient to implement the simulations. In addition to the gain and return loss of the component, they also consider the voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR). In addition, a near-field measurement system has been implemented in order to compare and contrast the performance of both theoretical and real antennas. The antenna configuration is capable of a wide variety of operations, including telemetry, GPS, RADAR, and Wi-Fi LANs.

articleTitle: Location Sensitive Browser App using MIT App Inventor for Blocking Social Media Websites in Educational Institutions
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper introduces a Location sensitive browser in mobile phone which is designed and implemented to block social media web sites in classrooms and auditorium to help avoid distraction in educational institutes for students and teachers. This presents the design, development and implementation of Mobile App in ios and android device using MIT App inventor. The developed app detects the location of the device and enables or disables social media websites based on the location. The Browser App is tested in the campus of UTAS- AlMusanna at different locations. The App allows access to educational websites like MS Outlook and MS Teams at all locations but blocks social media websites like Facebook, WhatsApp and YouTube inside classrooms and auditorium. This sample App is tested in the Electrical building, Mechanical Building, Auditorium, canteen and car parking space and the location sensor of mobile phone is reliable and consistent 90% of the time with the display of the latitude and longitude of the location.

articleTitle: Broadband and Wide Beam width Orthogonal dipole Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In this research, two ports are excited using double-loop (DL) dipoles with fan-shaped patches, resulting in a small dual-polarized broadband dipole antenna. In order to attain wide bandwidth, a single-loop (SL) crossed dipole antenna using a coaxial feeding structure is first constructed and analysed. Second, a third loop is used to achieve a fourth resonant mode without increasing the antenna's volume, which increases bandwidth and wide beam width with VSWR between 1 and 2. The stepped arms of the DL dipole antenna are designed to allow for independent mode adjustment. For a broadband-based application, the proposed antenna can also be built with an orthogonal dipole antenna. The designed antenna find some suitable application in Wireless applications.

articleTitle: RSSI: Overboard Localization System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A wireless sensor network (WSN) is an onboard processor that helps to manage and monitor the environment within a limited area. The work proposed here with WSN and overboard localization system is based on measuring the received signal strength indicator (RSSI) between fishermen or sailors in a boat to the control room in the port. The technology of RSSI is to provide location-based positioning and details of time despite all climatic conditions and even anywhere and at any time. This paper defines implementing a border identification system and safe evacuation in the boats to help the fishermen during emergencies. However, it is not that powerful to check the crime against fishermen, it gives only information about the border identification with the exact distance that the boat has traveled away from the border The proposed system's transmitter section includes an Arduino Mega microcontroller, RSSI module, voice playback circuit, and DC motor. The proposed system gives a warning when theboat crosses the sea border with a sound sensor. As the boat moves, the zone at which the boat and the signal strength will be displayed on the monitor placed in the port. During an emergency, an alert message is sent to the mobile phone or monitor. The receiver section has an RSSI and a personal computer/mobile phone for monitoring the database in the control room in the port. Localization is based on the weighted least mean squares (LMS) algorithm. This measurement offers better localization rate compared to other RSSI -based algorithms for localization.

articleTitle: A Survey on Ultra Wideband High Directivity Low Profile Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Antenna converts electronic waves into electromagnetic waves. In the present days of communication the antenna has to be versatile which can have wider applications. This is possible if the antenna is having wide range of operating frequency. At the same time to achieve high range of communication the antenna has to be very high directive. Thus a compact antenna with very high directivity and wide operating range of frequency is the need for many wireless communication systems & defence (RADAR, Unmanned Aerial Vehicle etc). This paper presents a survey on ultra-wideband high directivity low profile antenna. In this crowded world, wireless communication plays a prominent role in keeping us to stay connected, antenna is an important part of wireless communication system, after the extensive use of wireless communication, new growing ultra-wideband technology with advantages of less power consumption, less complexity, low cost, high data transmission, thin profile, conformability is used. Further ultra wide band micro strip patch antenna with improved characteristics of thin profile, high directivity becomes prominent feature of wireless communication. This paper discusses the existing survey works related to the topic.

articleTitle: Machine Learning and Wireless Sensor Network based Library Automation System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Remote sensor network and radio frequency identification innovation are on the world's outskirts. In this age of data innovation, the library as a repository for information gathering and distribution is critical. Innovations such as the personal computer, the Internet, and universal identification have sped the shift to the digital age. New improvements were integrated to configure Radio Frequency Identification remote organization with Wireless sensor network comprising hubs to work on the intelligent administration of the library, relying on manual and data the board. The three modules that were basically researched were writing seek positioning framework, book full casing framework, and programmed getting and returning entry monitor warning framework. The intelligent library framework based on Wireless sensor organization and Radio Frequency Identification incorporated sophisticated RFID and ZigBee technologies for the simplification and inclusion of writing assets, administration interface, and the library's administrative procedure. The significance of library computerization and smart collaboration was recognized, and the notion of individuals situated was fully explored. According to the findings, the smart library framework, which is based on wireless sensor organization and radio frequency identification, was able to fundamentally understand the smart library executives. To summarize, the framework creates an unpredictable library administration and board framework at any time and in any location.

articleTitle: Wi-Fi Enabled Power Extension Board for Energy Optimization and Control of Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: As a result of global technical advancements, smart home automation has become more popular in recent years. In their dwellings, touch-sensitive management gadgets are used to operate the fundamental functions like lighting, heating, and cooling. In order to create a productive infrastructure for wireless communication in the house, wireless sensor networks (WSNs) and concept of cloud computing are used. Without altering the current internal wiring and infrastructure, this project intends to simultaneously create a smart home environment and achieve energy efficiency for smart home applications.

articleTitle: Battery Management System Using IOT with Prediction Algorithm Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Failure and exploding of batteries in electric vehicles is the most vulnerable problem faced in recent days due to charging and discharging of energy in the battery. Due to charging and discharging the temperature of the battery will increase. There is no existing technology at present in the world to monitor the condition of EV's battery. So that this paper aims to check and monitor the energy percentage and temperature of the battery. The collected data is then transferred to the user using wireless transfer. By the most existing technology Internet of Things (IOT), using eps8266 controller which transfer the data and present conditions to the driver so that they identify the problem before it is too late. Also, we included a Machine Learning (ML) Algorithm in our system which predicts the lifespan of the battery by using the data collected in the controller so that the user can know the lifespan of the battery.

articleTitle: Implementation of Hyper Parameter Optimization in Liver Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Liver disease can be genetic. The liver can be damaged by alcohol use, obesity and hepatitis viruses. Chronic liver disease has many causes like Liver cancer, Cirrhosis and life threatening conditions. So prevention treatment can help to heal the damage and prevent liver failure. Hence, the time required to introduce the machine learning techniques which minimize the error and give more accuracy. Aim of this research paper is categories into two phases. In the first phase six classification algorithms (LR, KNN, SVM, NB, DT, and RF) are compared with ML Classification evaluation metrics. As a consequence, Logistic Regression obtained a higher accuracy of 71.6% in liver disease prediction than the other classification algorithms. In Phase 2, we selected a sample from a classification method with lower accuracy, such as Random Forest, Decision Tree algorithms and we adjusted the hyper parameters. RF accuracy is improved after Hyper Parameter Optimization by +4%, whereas Decision Tree algorithm accuracy is improved by +12%.

articleTitle: Automated Road Monitoring System Using CCTV with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Automated Road Monitoring System (ARMS) is an integrated system for reducing road accidents through surveillance. The main focus of this is on the signal mechanism on lull roads and the second one is the surveillance and alerting system that is helpful for the people in hilly regions and travelers. In developing countries accidents are the cause for death for the majority reasons. “Speed Kills”, but still people are lacking to drive safely on the road. Nowadays these people are the main reason for this road traffic accidents that are responsible for death as well as these also contribute a huge loss in the country's economy. About 23 million people die in India per year according to the Million Death Study (MDS). Out of these 137000 are because of road traffic accidents. That is about 377 people per day. We can see that many of them are curved roads. Thousands of people lose their lives each year because of this situation. As far as concerned, mountain road accidents are not considered to a level and these mountain accidents must be looked upon seriously. One of the solutions for this problem is alerting the driver about the vehicles coming from opposite sides in hair pin road sections. In India there are around 13.6% of accidents due to hilly curves. This system is one of the solutions for reducing these kinds of accidents by installing Automated Road surveillance systems in accident-prone regions. This integrated system also has an accident detection system that uses machine learning and image processing techniques for surveillance.

articleTitle: Computational System Based on Machine Learning with Novel Hybrid Security Technique to Classify Crime Offenses
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: To combat cybercrime, new cyber security measures are needed. The proposed approach uses advanced dynamic malware based on machine learning (ML). The proposed method emphases the risk score as well as the level of confidence. At first, we compare ML algorithms to determine the good recall, precision and F -measure. As the next step, the comparison of complete reputation system to other reputation systems have done. This approach decreases the risk level as compared to other approaches available in the literatures.

articleTitle: Roll Call Tracking System for Education Sectors Using Face Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A motion-based attendance system that assists in the recording and management of attendance without physical contact can be used in schools, institutions and colleges. Modern classrooms are equipped with various smart devices that have supporting software to improve the classrooms. However, it is often seen that precious time in the classroom is wasted on taking attendance, or the class may face various interruptions due to late entries of students, and this attendance procedure is done repeatedly. Conventional methods for attendance taking are by calling students' names by sensor-based card (RFID sensor) or biometric fingerprint-based attendance system, but all of these methods are inefficient as they can't tell whether the student has attended the full class or not. Thus, there is a need for an attendance management system which is totally motion based will assist the faculties and institute in marking the presence of the student attendance.

articleTitle: Comparative Examination of Interleaved Boost Converter With Voltage Multiplier Cells for Auxiliary Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In auxiliary power applications, the efficiency of the electrical system is improved by the auxiliary power supplies. Appropriate converters are required to quickly start and run for long periods of time with sufficient fuel. Various topologies suitable for auxiliary power applications are reported in the literature. These converters are proposed for various electrical loads with the aim of improving the performance of the auxiliary units. But this paper recommends a high increment multiphase interleaved boost converter for auxiliary power supplies. The topology uses the interleaving technique for the high gain boost converter to reduce both the input current and the output voltage ripple and improve efficiency. The proposed interleaved boost converter (ILBC) consists of voltage multiplier cells to enhance the gain. The simulation studies of the projected ILBC are performed in MATLAB/ SIMULINK and the results are verified.

articleTitle: Reliability Prediction of Bridgeless AC-DC SEPIC with V-Fill for LED Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: LED luminaires have been one of the lighting technologies that is presently most energy efficient and developing at a fast rate because of its long lifespan and outstanding luminous efficiency. To power the LED, power converters are used as LED drivers. In this paper, the reliability prediction of bridgeless AC-DC SEPIC (Single Ended Primary Inductance Converter) PFC (Power Factor Correction) integrated valley-fill (V -Fill) circuit has been developed for LED applications. The ability of a product to execute the necessary function under circumstances for a predetermined duration of time is referred to as reliability. Reliability is frequently assessed in terms of availability, frequency, and chance of failure. Preventing the occurrence of faults is the fundamental goal of reliability prediction. The choice of AC-DC PFC topology affects the overall reliability of led driver. To anticipate converter reliability, consideration must be given to the operational environment and time. Analyzing the power converter's condition is necessary to prevent converter replacement and downtime. As a result, this paper provides an illustration of the performance degradation analysis, reliability and failure investigation of individual components used in Bridgeless AC-DC SEPIC with V-Fill converter. Based on the MIL-HDBK-217F manual, the Part Stress Analysis (PSA) approach is used to compute every critical component failure rate (λ) and the mean time to failure (MTTF) of the converter. The PSA method requires more amount of information, and it is unable to give an exact value for reliability. Therefore, to predict an exact failure rate of critical components, a Bayesian Belief Network (BBN) method is used, and the BBN graphical structure of proposed converter, the failure rate of critical component, and MTTF is computed using GenIe software. The complex probability issues are efficiently computed via BBN. Therefore, the enhanced BBN technique can be an alternate to PSA approach in the lifetime study of LED drivers. It can produce exact data for designing long-lasting LED drivers, while also considerably increasing design/development efficiency and reducing costs.

articleTitle: Data Mining Classification Algorithms Applied to the Prediction of Heart Disease
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Although the healthcare sector is generally “information-rich,” sadly, not all data are mined, which is necessary for finding hidden patterns and making wise decisions. In medical research and especially in the prediction of heart disease, sophisticated data mining methods are used. These methods are also used to predict the data that is contained in databases. In this article, prediction systems for heart failure have been examined using a larger number of input attributes. The method analyses 13 variables, including medical words like sex, blood pressure, and cholesterol, to forecast the risk that a patient will develop heart disease. 13 attributes have been used for prediction. In this study, smoking and obesity were introduced as two more characteristics. In the existing systems, we have used Naïve Bayes and neural networking systems, which have less accuracy compared to the proposed system algorithms. On a database of heart diseases, the proposed data mining classification algorithms J48 Decision Trees, Bagging, and Adaboost are examined. Based on the accuracy, these techniques' performances are contrasted. According to our findings, the Adaboost, J48 decision tree, and bagging accuracy are 92.1 percent, 91.62 percent, and 90.52 percent, respectively. Our investigation reveals that Adaboost, out of these three classification methods, accurately predicts heart failure.

articleTitle: Computational Investigation of Jet Mixing Enhancement by C-D Nozzle with Arc Tabs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The present computational investigation of the nozzle exit flow from C-D nozzle investigates the augmentation in mixing, jet decay and flow characteristics of jet from the supersonic nozzle with arc tab and without tab at the nozzle outlet for a Mach 2. ANSYS Fluent software is used to design the convergent divergent nozzle with design modeler and to simulate if for the design Mach number. The simulations are also carried out for overexpanded and under-expanded conditions in both the cases with NPRs 6 and 7.4. The jets from the nozzle with arc tab and without tab are compared using pressure and Mach number contour plots. The shock-cell formation with alternate expansion waves and compression waves are observed clearly. As the arc tab is included at the nozzle exit, the length and quantity of shock cells decreases. This leads to a decrement in strength of the shock and results in a faster decay in the case of nozzle with tab. The shock diamond or Mach disks observed at the kink of the barrel shock reduces with increase in flow direction. The nozzle with arc tab has a superior mixing enhancement as compared to nozzle without tab.

articleTitle: Trackme - Smart Watch for Women Safety
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Although the world has become technologically much advanced, Crimes against women and children are still exceptionally high. Our vision is to alert nearby people and send SMS through GSM module for desired contacts and nearby police station which is traced using the GPS and A button that could initiate all the above mentioned process inorder to trace the location of the user along with latitude and longitudinal information via satellite communication immediately once pressed by the user. The further enhancements include video and audio of the situation as a record of evidence. Our project focuses on developing a smartwatch for women to protect themselves from any danger or ill situations. Our project mainly focuses to enhance the safety of women by sending messages to the preassigned contacts in case of any emergency situations.

articleTitle: DC Charge Accumulation Characteristics of 11 kV Polymeric Insulator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The properties of the silicon rubber polymeric insulators are prone to be affected by the accumulation of surface charges. The present work aims to measure the surface charge accumulation on the sheds of an 11 kV polymeric insulator due to the applied voltage for various time durations. The charges deposited on the surface of the insulator will increase with voltage and with time and reaches saturation after a specific time. The insulator is energized for a predetermined time, and the charges on the sheds close to the electrodes are measured within 10 seconds after switching off the supply using an electrometer. The surface charge density is computed using the Finite Element Analysis tool and compared with the experimental values.

articleTitle: Smart Earthquake Detector and Rescuing System for Differently Abled Person
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The paper's major focus is on earthquake detection and ways to save the lives of people with disabilities. People typically flee to safer locations after earthquakes, but those who are physically impaired or in a wheelchair face numerous challenges if they are left alone at home. If they are unable to walk or even use their hands, they must endure great hardship. The purpose of this research work is to try and lessen the difficulties faced by wheelchair users. In this study, a straightforward earthquake indicator that can detect even a point vibration utilizing an Arduino board and a very sensitive accelerometer is shown. Then it produces a signal to tell the physically challenged individual to depart more quickly. According to this research work, a person with a disability can evacuate during an earthquake by using his mental and meditation skills. A tool called the mind wave mobile that uses brain wave technology makes this feasible. Additionally, when an earthquake is detected, GSM messaging techniques are used to send a message alarm to any nearby guardians who can assist that physically challenged person. When there is an earthquake, if the person with a disability is unable to utilize his mind wave due to various conditions, a guardian nearby once again receives an SMS or Call to save him.

articleTitle: Distributed Network Welfare Maximization DSM-DG Strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This methodology aims in regulating the parameters of demand response management (DRM) to limit the usage of consumer energy. Therefore, this will increase the stability and minimizes the cost of generation. Synchronized optimization of IoT based distributed generation (DG) parameters with DRM programs ensure the trapping of the obtainable power and maintain the welfare maximization. Comprehensive cases are taken into consideration by optimizing the DG parameters. This control proposes a strawberry (SBY) optimization to effectively manage the resources. To justify the integration of dynamic generation and demand parameters, a standard IEEE 33bus system is considered and the results show that the proposed optimization technique improves the system performance.

articleTitle: An Efficient Task scheduling and Data security in Heterogeneous Cloud Computing using Hybrid Meta-Heuristic Algorithm and Block Chain based Key Aggregate Cryptosystem
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Cloud computing is a rapidly growing technology which is hugely used in various fields and it offers a strong and fashionable corporate environment. However, cloud computing environment faces many challenges in scheduling and securing the huge amount of data provided by various users. To overcome the conventional performance limitations in resource scheduling and data security various optimization and encryption models are evolved in recent times. However, the performances can be improved if hybrid models are employed. Thus, a hybrid Ant Colony Optimization-Variable Neighborhood Search(ACO-VNS) metaheuristic algorithm is presented in this research work to improved task scheduling. Furthermore, to handle user data security and privacy a combination of Attribute Based Encryption (ABE) with (BKAC) blockchain based key aggregate cryptosystem technique is presented. simulation analysis includes standard benchmark datasets and the performances are compared to existing techniques such as Energy -Efficient Dynamic Scheduling Scheme (EDS), Cross Entropy based Virtual Machine (CEVP), Meta-Heuristic Crow Search Algorithm (H3CSA), PPSO (Parallel Particle Swarm Optimization) and Block Chain based CP-ABE Scheme with Partially Hidden Access Policy (BCP-ABE-PHAS) to validate the superior performance. The experimental result demonstrates the performance of the proposed meta-heuristic and ABE-BKAC model in terms of completion ratio, response time, make span, energy consumption, keygen time, Encryption Time and Decryption Time.

articleTitle: Pocket-sized gadget for detection of Liquefied crude oil in Molecular state with IOT enabled lightning notification system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In recent years, gas leaks have become a major problem in households that use household gas, so we have developed the proposed gas leak detection and monitoring system. An LPG leak-detecting system prevents risks like gas cylinder explosions. Given the widespread usage and demand for LPG, this device aids in routine LPG monitoring and alerts users to potential dangers brought on by LPG leaks. In this study, we used Google Firebase to create an IoT -integrated gas leak detection system. This product is designed to make it impossible for gas leaks to occur indoors in structures like homes or buildings. It is packed in a small rectangular box. NodeMCU ESP8266 is adopted as the main controller, and MQ-5 is adopted as the gas sensor. Since this product is equipped with IoT (Internet of Things), a remote notification is sent via a smartphone app when a gas leak is detected. Test findings showed that a 1 cm distance between the sensor and its controller produced a reaction time of 0.80 seconds and a push notice to the application in 1.60 seconds.

articleTitle: Cascaded Fuzzy Logic Algorithm for Multi-Functional Control of PMSG Based WECS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The development of a suitable controller methodology is instrumental in obtaining significant enhancement of wind energy conversion systems (WECSs). In this work, a robust Cascaded Fuzzy Logic Controller (CFLC) is employed for improving the operation of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator (PMSG) based WECS. The newly introduced CFLC is designed based on the operational parameters of the PMSG. Since WECS is a variable power source, the power obtained from it is characterized with intermittency, so by adding a battery to the network, the ceaseless power supply is ensured. The interfacing of the battery to network requires a Bidirectional DC-DC Converter (BDC), which significantly assists in the process of discharging and charging of the battery using Proportional (PI) controller. The Grid Side Converter (GSC) is also controlled effectively using CFLC, for attaining effectual grid voltage synchronization. The evaluation of the claim of the proposed regulator methodology is done with MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Routine Irrigation System Controlled and Monitored by IoT Using Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the Indian sub-continent, one-third of the economy completely depends on agriculture and agriculture is a foremost occupation for Indians. Agriculture is the most significant and oldest profession for Indian families. Here, agriculture is varied from terrain to terrain based on the soil conditions, rainfall, and a lot more. Watering farmland is one challenging task for the farmers and now recent technologies may help the farmers to impoverish their farmland in terms of yield of cultivation. Inculcating advanced emerging technologies in agriculture can able to provide a solution for their prevalent issue called irrigation. The agriculture of a nation gets enhanced then the economy can be increased so, this article suggests an novel idea for the welfare of farmers and this concept might be supporting farmers to irrigate their farmlands from dawn to dusk. Nearly five million tube-wells were irrigating Indian farmlands and farmers are controlling the quantity of water discharges to the fields manually and hence water resources are wasted by over watering the fields. In this view to save water and workload of the farmers, this proposed methodology provides a solution for the above-listed difficulties using IoT. This proposed system was premeditated to surmount the superfluous water flow into the agricultural farming lands and also provides an intellectual monitoring platform framework. This includes sensor networks that can able sense pH level, rate of water flow with temperature and soil moisture conditions. This data is supportive of the smart irrigation system to water the field on time with the required amount of water to the fields. With a soil moisture content of 60%, the maximum temperature has been set at 32 degrees Celsius and the minimum temperature can range from 15 to 28 degrees Celsius.

abstract: Grinder is kitchen equipment which is used to mix and grind various food items. This appliance makes our work easy. Now-a-days, mostly in every south Indian's house, grinder is mandatory. articleTitle: Augmented Reality-Based Restaurants
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The modern world requires a system that can better understand and meet people's needs than it now does. The restaurant industry is looking for apps that can improve the eating experience while also increasing earnings. The hologram menu will fundamentally transform the dining experience for diners. The system, by definition, is a traditional ordering system in which a waiter takes the client's order, places it with the kitchen, and then bills them, which takes time and can be erroneous. The approach entails automating restaurant ordering and paying operations, which will dramatically improve customers' dining experiences. The menu for food items is displayed using holograms around the dining table in an augmented reality-based food serving system. The major aspects highlighted here to promote effective meal ordering in a restaurant are the simplicity of the menu and convenience of access to a menu. The customer's menu selection will be sent to the hotel's kitchen department through the ZigBee Wireless Transmission module, where the request to order food in the kitchen area will be entirely automated, decreasing customer wait times and ensuring efficient food ordering. The Arduino Uno, which controls the LCD and the Buzzer in the kitchen part, provides the alarm. This study primarily attempts to increase restaurant and caterer efficiency by decreasing human mistakes, hence saving time and offering better customer service.

articleTitle: A Fast and Robust Regression Model for Keyframes Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In recent days, multimedia content has been developed from multiple resources such as social media video content, video surveillance, etc. Due to rapid increasing the volume of digital data, analysis and retrieval of the video will be time consuming. Due to continuous frame count, retrieving content of the video from large databases is a challenging one. To overcome the above challenge, this paper introduces a regression model to extract the information that is derived from frame sequence that uses two statistical features on the frame. This model can be applied on any kinds of video data to extend several multimedia applications and experiments for scene understanding, video summarization, etc Finally, user generated video where static video and dynamic videos and VIRAT benchmark dataset are evaluated by demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed work.

articleTitle: Heptagonal Fractal Antenna with Slit for Improved Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The demand for antennas with high gain, compact size and light weight is increasing due to advancement in technology. Antenna with wide coverage area is desirable for many applications. In order to support antenna with low profile and wide coverage area, it is proposed to choose Fractal antennas operating at 2.4 GHz. The designed Sierpinski fractal antenna operates at ISM band. To employ the antenna for wearable applications, the specific absorption should be less than 1.6W/Kg. With the advent of fractal structures, the dimension of antenna is reduced and there is no necessity that the size need to follow the relation with wavelength of operation. For bandwidth enhancement a slot is made at the center of the resonator. The antenna proposed is cheaper and is suitable for applications like Wifi, Bluetooth, Audio visual devices, and smart power meters as well as for Radio control units. Here, the comparative study of fractal antennas for different shapes is performed and the antenna with better performance was considered for fabrication.

articleTitle: Effective Analysis of Human Cardiovascular Disease via Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Heart is contemplated as the most vivacious organ of living organisms. The most important cause of mortality around the globe these days is due to heart disease. This complication can occur at any point in life be it juvenile, old, or middle age. Prediction of heart disease is a major challenge in the world of medicines. Machine learning plays a significant role in the diagnosis and early prediction of fatal diseases. We have used Cleveland, Hungary, Switzerland, and Long Beach V (UCI repository) dataset for training the models. The algorithms used for increasing the accuracy and predicting the presence of cardiovascular disease are SVM, Decision Tree, K Nearest Neighbor, eXtreme Gradient Boosting, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Naive Bayesian. All these algorithms are ensembled via Voting Classifier. 35 different combinations are analyzed and the highest accuracy of 97.3658% can be achieved with ensembling K Nearest Neighbor, eXtreme Gradient Boosting and Decision Tree algorithms in addition with 5-fold cross validation which is followed by accuracy of 97.0731% using eXtreme Gradient Boosting, Decision Tree Classifier and SVM. In order to implement, the python programming Google Colab notebook has been used as it has multiple types of libraries and header files.

articleTitle: System for Prioritizing Covid-19 Patients Based on Certain Parameters

abstract: Over numerous nations on earth, a brand-new virus known as the corona virus has been spreading like wildfire. We have created a decision-making method based on a few parameters and X-rays to identify the priority of patients. The Mask R- CNN technique is used to train and test on the dataset to classify patients as having COVID infection or not. On chest X-ray pictures, the mask R CNN technique enhances COVID - 19 detection performance.

articleTitle: Harmonic Elimination with Multilevel Inverter Based Hybrid Filter Using Artificial Intelligence Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Harmonics in the distribution system are caused by the fast growth of nonlinear loads based on power electronics. Harmonics reduce the quality of the power and the effectiveness of the power system. As a result, getting rid of it is crucial. This study evaluates a hybrid filter based on a cascaded H-bridge multilevel inverter for decreasing source current harmonics in a high-voltage system. The hybrid filter topology includes a double-tuned passive filter and a cascaded H-bridge MLI-based active filter in a shunt at the point of common coupling. To lower the compensation cost, the shunt passive filter suppresses low-order dominant 5th and 7th harmonics, whereas the shunt active filter eliminates high-order harmonics. To increase system performance, an approach based on artificial intelligence is employed to create compensation current and DC link voltage control. Switching pulses for cascaded MLI are produced using a multiband hysteresis current controller. The harmonic distortion in source current (THDi) is measured under different compensation methods. The system response is observed for steady state and dynamic state. The system is developed and evaluated using MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Smart Energy Meter With Cloud Connectivity

articleTitle: Automation of Traffic Control Systems with Deep Q-Learning Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Traffic signal infrastructure is used to manage the flow of traffic and vehicle congestion that occurs on the road. In cities with high population densities and smart cities, traffic has been extremely hard to control, and vehicle delay times have been immense. High congestion due to traffic has caused an increase in the delay times of passengers and the need for an effective traffic control system. Thus, there is a need for automated traffic control systems. Tampering and altering the signals may cause traffic jams and can cause a delay due to signals displaying an incorrect phase for a particular intersection or junction. By implementing a Deep Q-Learning (DQN) network, the traffic signals can be automated with more efficiency. This algorithm will take into account the cumulative number of vehicles at the signal, and the vehicles' delay time and identify which signal phase to output. Instead of waiting for a full phase cycle to switch signals, the signals can change phases reactively to real-world traffic. Data about the vehicle's presence, vehicle count, and delay time are collected to predict the correct phase of a given signal. The significance of an attack can be quantified by a delay in travel time caused to a vehicle on the road. The model will take the vehicles' presence in each lane of the road from SUMO and identify which signal phase to produce as output, so the cumulative vehicle time can be minimized, i.e. delay time of vehicles at any instance is reduced. The machine learning model will predict which phase to change to, and the reinforcement learning algorithm will determine if the output has resulted in a desirable condition and provide arbitrary rewards as output. Implementing the DQN algorithm in place of the round-robin algorithm has reduced the cumulative vehicle delay time which is the time taken to reach a given destination and vehicle queue length.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Error-free Cooperative Transmission for Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Cooperative communication is among the most effective approaches in wireless networks because of the geographical diversity gain it can provide. Relay nodes take advantage of the broadcasting characteristics of wireless transmissions to pick up signals from the source and transmit them to the reception. New requirements, like energy efficiency and quality-of-service (QoS), are placed on certain networks by real-time applications, which cannot be met by the current communication infrastructure. Data loss throughout communication is common in challenging environments, that could degrade transmission reliability. It has been demonstrated that network coding (NC) is a useful approach that may be thought of as a packet-level error-correction technique. Having more redundancy and less time required for retransmitting lost data makes the system more reliable. In this paper, an Energy Efficient Error-free Cooperative Transmission (EEECT) technique for wireless networks is proposed. It has an adaptive burst error correction (ABEC) scheme for correcting the burst losses and a channel state estimation scheme for reliable transmission. By applying these schemes in the relay nodes, cooperative transmission is achieved. Experimental results show that the proposed EEECT technique achieves minimum delay and Packet Error Rate (PER) with increased packet delivery ratio and residual energy.

articleTitle: Bio-Inspired Optimization Algorithm in Optimum Relay Selection for Cooperative Transmission Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Multipath propagation, which causes channel fading, is one of the significant flaws in wireless network signal transmission. Cooperative Communication (CC) is a technique for reducing the impact of channel fading by leveraging the diversity gain made available by collaborating with several nodes and/or relays. Because of the size and complexity limits of wireless mobile devices, nodes with more than one transmitting antenna are uncommon. The scenario entails investigating a network that includes a sender, a receiver, and a relay. Two common CC mechanisms for increasing transmission reliability are amplifying and forward and decoding and forward. Relay nodes gather, process, and retransmit data to improve the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) at the receiving end. To improve the overall efficiency of the system, we propose bio-inspired systems in which two parties exchange data via distinct relay nodes. The Artificial Immune System Algorithm (AIS) and Bacterial Foraging Optimization (BFO) are used in this study to provide a strategy for identifying the most effective relay to employ in CC. The Relay Selection (RS) technique considers criteria such as outage likelihood, collision risk, Bit Error Rate (BER), and energy utilization during CC. To validate the effectiveness of both techniques, delay, Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR), Residual Energy (RE), and outage probability are employed.

articleTitle: Automated Classification of MRI Brain Images
