articleTitle: A Novel technique for automatic blackboard cleaning system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A growing technological advancement calls for greater performance machines to fulfill human and market demands The world today demands that everything be automated, notably in the disciplines of engineering, teaching, and medical science. The boards used in schools and universities are frequently observed to be about 20 feet broad. Additionally, cleaning these chalkboards by hand when they are fully written on takes longer than a minute. If a class lasts an hour, then 10-12% of that time will be lost cleaning such a large board with a tiny duster. Additionally, the chalk dust that remains after the board has been erased poses a threat to human health. A fantastic alternative to the conventional duster is the “Automatic Board Cleaning Device.” We chose this activity to give teachers some solace as they wiped the chalkboard. With the use of DC geared motors, this automatic board cleaning system uses an aluminium track and wheel arrangement that moves horizontally to clean the chalkboard. In order to wet wipe the board, it is further modified by the addition of a sprinkler and blower. By using this method, you can quickly clean the chalkboard, which saves you time compared to manually scrubbing it.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Covid-19 from Chest X-Ray Images Using Wavelet-Based Depth Wise Convolution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: There is a great need to create and put in place a method of automatic detection as a substitute for conventional diagnosis for COVID-19 detection that can be employed on a commercialscale because there aren't as many COVID-19 test kits availablein medical institutions. In particular, chest X-Ray scans can beexamined to assess whether a patient has COVID. Due to the availability of numerous big annotated picture datasets, convolutional neural networks have achieved remarkable success in image analysis and classification. Input is obtained in the form of chest x-rays images. Output results are acquired instantly in real-time which predicts if the person suffers from Covid or not. Modern technique use the RCNN algorithm, which makes them less precise and time-consuming. We suggest an automated deep learning-base method for extracting COVID-19 from chest X-ray pictures. For analysing the chest X-Ray pictures, suggested method offers enhanced depth-wise convolution neural network. Through wavelet decomposition, multiresolution analysis is incorporatedinto the network. In order to identify the condition, the network is given the frequency sub-bands that were recovered from the input pictures. The network's goal is to determine whether the input image belongs to the Covid-19 class or not. The Advantage of the proposed system are that it could be the very first-of its kind, cost-efficient, and highly accurate application that provide complete and accurate covid - 19 diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Survey of Circulating Tumor Cells Segmentation and Classification Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Circulating tumor cells (CTCs) are very small cells carried around the body in blood circulation. CTC is the origin for metastases which denotes the tumor cells move from the original location to other organs or parts of the body over blood circulation. The early detection of CTC cells is used for patient risk assessment and to appraise treatment outcomes. Recently, image processing-based solutions have received more achievement in the field of medicine. CTC detection in the micro-scope image requires more effort due to its size and intensity. This work surveys various image processing algorithms used in CTC detection. Also, reviews different machine and deep learning models used in medical image segmentation and classification.

articleTitle: Aiderbot: DTMF Based Medical Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Traditionally, high technology robots are applied on medical field known for its accuracy and reliability but the cost of those robots are too expensive but a tool nonetheless. In this paper, we introduce DTMF (Dual Tone Multi Frequency) that can be paired with the robot to control it remotely using telephone with ease for the patients. This robot is capable of functioning various operations like cleaning, serving, recommending doctor or nurse assistant when needed. The robot is controlled with a micro controller which is integrated with DTMF decoder and motors to help robot move around using path memorizing algorithm. With the inter-connection of various essential components and with use of a telephone as a remote we can operate the robot from anywhere with all the safety measures such as security. The cost of this robot to deploy in hospitals is very less when compared to other automated robot services.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Electric Cycle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The global vehicle fleet is expanding rapidly. Vehicles pollute the world's cities, emitting rising volumes of carbon dioxide and other climate-altering greenhouse gases, because of massive amounts of petroleum usage. The frightening fact is that automotive application is expanding significantly faster than the human population, with no end in sight. If the current trend continues, nearly 3 billion automobiles might be in use by 2050, outnumbering 20 cars per 100 persons. The usage of electric vehicles is necessary to combat these consequences, and today's automakers are converting their automobiles to E- Vehicles. Additionally, it is quite affordable and user-friendly. Converting bicycles to electric cycles is one alternative method.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of RPL performance under different wireless network topologies
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: IPV6 Routing Protocol for Low Power Lossy Networks (RPL) is one of the routing protocols that can be used for Internet of Things networks based applications. In this study, the performance of RPL with linear and ellipse topologies is examined. Two scenarios are considered case 1, all nodes are assumed to be static, while case 2, some nodes are made dynamic. In terms of Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR), control overhead, convergence time and energy usage, RPL's performance on these topologies is assessed. The analysis is performed in a COOJA simulator environment. The topology with improved energy efficiency and reliability is chosen. The outcomes demonstrate that elliptical topology performs admirably in both situations.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Wavelet Transforms for Denoising MRI Brain Images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Clinical practice, such as diagnosis, treatment, and findings from linked studies heavily rely on medical imaging. Medical images are frequently tainted or deformed during image acquisition and transmission due to various sounds, camera focus issues, blood flow disturbances, and atmospheric turbulence. Therefore, image denoising processing is required in order to enhance the image quality. When functional analysis and statistics come together, the hunt for effective image denoising techniques continues to be a valid problem. In order to denoise a brain imaging resonance for medical purposes, this research analyses the effectiveness of various thresholding methods based on wavelets when there is speckle noise for different wavelet families, including Morlet, Symlet, Daubechies, and Haar. SNR (Signal to Noise Ratio), PSNR(Peak signal to noise ratio (Peak Signal to Noise Ratio), and MSE(Mean Square Error) are used for performance evaluation and analysis. The assessment of performance suggests that symlet wavelet transform seems to be more efficient because it can effectively capture a signal's energy in a small number of well known energy transform values.

articleTitle: Grid connected single-stage multiport inverter with two independent source
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In this paper, two independent dc sources are converted in a single-stage into a three-phase ac source. In this system, two independent sources photovoltaic (PV) cells and Fuel cells or batteries are used. Two sources can be magnetically isolated towards the circuit by the use of coupled inductor. In single-stage both converter and inverter are integrated into a circuit which has more advantages than the dual-stage. In this system, bulky capacitors are reduced and only one dc link is used. The Proposed system has high voltage gain, lesser harmonics (THD), reduced number of semiconductors, switching loss is minimized and component stress is also reduced. Balanced three-phase output is obtained by Sinusoidal pulse width modulation (SPWM) by setting the reference voltage or carrier signal. The balanced three-phase output is given to the grid or to run a three-phase induction motor. It can also be done using space vector modulation (SVPWM) which effectively utilizes the DC power. Multiple renewable energy can be connected to this three-phase voltage source inverter (VSI) and a buck-boost converter with a single switch(MOSFET) is used to control the whole system using a PID controller. The Experiment is done in a PIC microcontroller. This multiport inverter is done in MATLAB Simulink. Thus the output is verified and discussed below.

articleTitle: Gas Leakage Detection And Refilling System With Automated Fault Clearness
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In recent trends, everything becomes automated and there are many technologies involved in it. In our home, we are using Liquid Petroleum Gas for Cooking Purposes. The gas leakage detection system is done by DC Motor and Solenoid Valve. The intention is to locate the gas leak, notify the user through SMS, and automatically turn off the gas regulator. Then, the electrical equipment in the home is turned off automatically by using an electromechanical relay. The Gas level indication is also sent to the user. The Gas Booking for refilling gas is also done automatically when the gas regulator is removed from the gas cylinder for a few seconds of time. These things are done by using IOT Cloud Applications. These functions are performed by Arduino. The Arduino has the authentication of users and regulating capability of electrical equipment in the home for security purposes.

articleTitle: A robust deep learning method for radiation induced pulmonary fibrosis disease classification in lung CT-a review
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A chronic lung condition called pulmonary fibrosis damages the tissues of the lungs by inflaming, scarring, thickening, and hardening them. This uses CT images, which have the potential to be more effective than X-rays. In order to accurately segment the PF lesions for diagnosis and treatment monitoring, CT is crucial in the observation of lung fibrosis brought on by radiation (PF). The work is complicated by the lesions' varied positions and sizes, uncertain boundaries, irregular shapes, and the difficulty of obtaining a sizable collection of volumetric images with annotations for learning. A deep learning model is what we describe in implementation with Framework for semi-supervised learning with iterative confidence-based refinement and weighting of fictitious labels (I-CRAWL) to tackle these problems. Image pre-processing, segmentation, feature extraction, and classification are steps in the process. A number of augmentation and fragmentation approaches are used to produce more accurate results. Based on the classification of the pictures using classification algorithms, the disorders in the CT images were identified.

articleTitle: IoT and Machine Learning Technology based Smart Shopping System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In today's environment, traditional shopping is a time-consuming activity. Customers must wait in huge lines at the pay counter in traditional shopping. As a result, both the client and the clerk waste a lot of time and energy. To combat this interaction, we're pushing a fantastic shopping framework built on an Android app. The user must first download and install the software on his or her Android phone in this framework. He then scans the item's QR code and enters the required amount. After that, the object is put onto the car. Customers buy the items and put them into the trucks in this manner. The client can add or remove items from the vehicle. The customer will be given the recommended items as well as the most convenient method of obtaining them. When the items are purchased, the bill is generated. This bill might be sent to the client's mobile device via internet banking, allowing the consumer to make a quick payment and leave the business sooner.

articleTitle: Water Quality Detection using Computer Vision and IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The most indispensable natural resources on earth are water. Water is the life blood of planet earth and mankind. It is essential for social well-being, economic prosperity, and quality of life. The emerging technologies and population have degraded the water resources abundantly. This paper deliberates on the water assets administration and progressing the productivity of water. The sequence of this paper discusses about detecting and continuously monitoring rain humidity, changing water levels, water current, water pollution, availability of power requirements at remote areas, activities of birds /animals/humans, wind speed, Dissolved Oxygen (DO), Total Dissolve Solids (TDS), pH level, etc. The technology we implemented here is a miniature floating bot integrated system with diverse sensors that keep a beady eye on the efficiency and nutrient content of the water body and transmit the real-time database. The statistics observed by the bot system will be transmitted to the cloud database through a Wi-Fi module. The data values were also inspected through a mobile application. Here cost-effective sensors and IoT devices are used to monitor long-term changes in the quality & quantity of surface water.

articleTitle: Aegis Surtout
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The project deals with the dedicated security framework for women. The crimes of harassment, molestation, abduction, and assaults that are happening against women are skyrocketing. In today's scenario, every woman from all walks of life struggles to face her solitude situations in public spaces where they are more prone to get harassed. In this paper, a smart wearable women's safety assistant jacket that has an automated emergency alert system is presented. This system alerts parents and police forces by GPRS. The jacket is equipped with an integrated system of a shock generating circuit that is meant for self-defense mechanisms. This module is activated by a pressure sensor via a microcontroller and will generate a voltage that is sufficient enough to put someone into muscular contraction. The pressure sensor will be activated when the pressure applied against it goes beyond a certain limit that will occur when the attacker squeeze, pinch, or grab the chest, abdomen, and other areas of the woman where the jacket is equipped with the sensors. The force applied in a simple hug or touch does not activate the device. Heartbeat sensors and voice recognition modules are also added up to enhance security.

articleTitle: Link Correlation Procedure for Improving Energy Efficiency in Homogeneous WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The wireless sensor network (WSN) is a multi-hop wireless network which include s numerous sensor nodes prearranged in a self-organized mode. In this approach all sensor nodes have the same energy, same transmission range. Many clustering approaches have been introduced to reduce the energy utilization during data transmission in the WSN. Nowadays clustering algorithms established on data correlation have been extensively examined. A correlation operation is a centralized greedy clustering. But, in a centralized model, additional energy is necessary to receive a global information, and increase delay. To solve these issues, Link Correlation procedure for improving energy efficiency (LCIE) in homogeneous WSN is introduced. This paper explained clustering approach for a homogeneous WSN that establishes a single-hop communication within cluster using link correlation. The multi-hop communication among Cluster Head (CH) is controlled by network coding. We perform simulations in the Network simulator to validate the performance of the LCIE approach. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach has minimized the transmission energy consumption and improved the network throughput in the WSN.
